- candidate `chunk-96c285a9dbfad3d55f4ee72a9860bd74` doc=doc-0b20024c57c212406bf68b660f2eaf30 words=0-400 distance=0.293615 similarity=0.706385 sections=[Rockets Rockets > Rocket Tiers Rockets > Questbook Rockets > Space Travel Rockets > Space Travel > Building Launchpad Rockets > Space Travel > Rocket Controls] text="A Tier 1 Rocket, on launch pad\nThe Rocket is a vehicle added by the Galacticraft mod that enables travel to different planets . These planets often contain ore veins and underground fluid veins which are inaccessible in other dimensions and are required for Tier progression.\nRocket Tiers\nRocket | Tier | Destinations\nRocket: T1 | Tier: HV | Destinations: Moon\nRocket: T2 | Tier: EV | Destinations: Deimos, Mars, Phobos\nRocket: T3 | Tier: IV | Destinations: Asteroids, Callisto, Ceres, Europa, Ganymede, Ross128b\nRocket: T4 | Tier: IV | Destinations: Io, Mercury, Venus\nRocket: T5 | Tier: LuV | Destinations: Enceladus, Miranda, Oberon, Titan, Ross128ba\nRocket: T6 | Tier: ZPM | Destinations: Proteus, Triton\nRocket: T7 | Tier: UV | Destinations: Haumea, Kuiper Belt, Makemake, Pluto\nRocket: T8 | Tier: UHV | Destinations: Barnard C, Barnard E, Barnard F, Alpha Centauri Bb, T Ceti E, Vega B\nRocket: T9 | Tier: UEV | Destinations: Horus, Maahes, Anubis, Neper, Seth, Mehen Belt\nThe T9 planets require a Mothership and Shuttle Rockets to travel to.\nQuestbook\nThe Better Questing quest tab for rockets, \"Space Race\", unlocks upon completing the IV Circuits and HV Assembling Machine quests in the HV quest tab. It contains the progression for rocket tiers, space survival systems, and rocket fuels, starting with a quest to craft the NASA Workbench.\nSpace Travel\nBuilding Launchpad\nThe Rocket requires rocket fuel and a launch pad to launch.\n- A launch pad is formed by placing a 3x3 square on the ground of Galacticraft Launch Pads. Right click to place a rocket on the launch pad.\n- A Galacticraft Fuel Loader can be placed next to the launch pad. It requires 91 EU/s to run. Once a rocket is placed on the launch pad, the Fuel Loader will pipe fuel from its tank into the rocket. A Fuel Loader can be filled with Galacticraft Liquid Canisters, fluid cells or piped in through a tank. All tiers of rocket hold enough fuel capacity for at least one round trip. The Tier 1 Rocket holds up to 5 Buckets of fuel.\nRocket Controls\n- Interact with the rocket to enter it\n- Interact again or sneak to leave it\n- While on the rocket, press space to ignite the rocket and begin a launch; begins a 20-second countdown to launch, which cannot be cancelled.\n- By default, the key to view the inventory/fuel"
- candidate `chunk-31faa32469fc6faf139f774cff61feea` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=960-1360 distance=0.316120 similarity=0.683880 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Tier 6 Rocket Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Infrastructure Improvements Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power Generation Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Infrastructure Improvements > Lasers] text="has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. There are two planets available, Proteus and Triton, both moons of Neptune. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . Deuterium and Ethylene are available as underground fluids from a Fluid Drilling Rig . The Tier 6 Rocket also unlocks the ability to make Planetary Gas Siphons above Neptune for Tritium, Helium-3, Ammonia, and Xenon.\nInfrastructure Improvements\nPower Generation\nIn ZPM, most existing power generation methods from earlier tiers, such as Nitrobenzene , Rocket Fuel, and Nuclear Reactors , remain viable, but start to fall off due to increasing power demands and a lack of upgrades. One notable upgrade is Huge Turbines for all gas, steam, or plasma-based power, which are unlocked with Americium.\nPlasma, on the other hand, is still viable and will continue to be viable for many more tiers. In addition to the aforementioned Huge Turbines, plasma benefits from better fuels in the form of Tin Plasma or Runite Plasma (although the latter requires a UV Alloy Blast Smelter ), better production rates using the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, and the XL Plasma Turbine and XL Supercritical Steam Turbine to greatly improve power throughput.\nA Large Naquadah Reactor.\nZPM also unlocks one of the strongest power generation methods in the mid and late game: Naquadah Fuel, often abbreviated to Naqfuel. Power is produced by inputting Naqfuel into a Large Naquadah Reactor (LNR), alongside Liquid Air, a coolant (Gelid Cryotheum), and an excited liquid (Molten Atomic Separation Catalyst), all of which will need to be produced in large quantities by players seeking to use the fuel for power. Two tiers of Naqfuel are available in ZPM: tier 1 requires the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, while tier 2 is produced by combining tier 1 fuel with a couple other ingredients in an overclocked Mega Chemical Reactor . Each LNR can generate up to 42.9M EU/t with Naqfuel 1, and up to 101.2M EU/t with Naqfuel 2.\nLasers\nLasers are a new way to distribute power that are much better than cables on throughput, flexibility, and expandability, at the cost of being more expensive to make. Lasers are started by Laser Source Hatches on multiblocks that accept them (including the Lapotronic"
- candidate `chunk-1e6573a223741457083ff1b74c3eabbb` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=960-1360 distance=0.318987 similarity=0.681013 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Mothership Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power Production Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > UHV Capacitor] text="station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar.\nInfrastructure Improvements\nPower Production\nThe only viable power sources in UHV are Plasma and Naquadah Fuel.\nThe Tier 8 Rocket provides access to Tartarite, meaning Celestial Tungsten Plasma, the best plasma fuel in the game, is available. Plasma also benefits from new rotor materials, such as Infinity Catalyst or Infinity, that significantly improve the amount of power that can be produced from a single turbine. Compact Fusion Reactors become much more affordable in UHV as well, making Plasma significantly easier to scale.\nNaquadah Fuel gains access to the Naquadah Fuel Refinery once Bio Circuits are made. This multiblock is used to produce all tiers of Naquadah Fuel above Mk2, each of which is a significant upgrade over its predecessor. Naq3 provides over 4x the EU/t when compared to Naq2, at the cost of somewhat more Heavy Naquadah Fuel and some additives; it can also be doubled by using the Chromatic Glass recipe, but this requires large amounts of Hyper-Intensity Laser Engravers to support. Naq4 is also possible to make in UHV, if either Nano Resin, Meteors, or Depleted Thorium Fuel are used to source the Praseodymium.\nUHV Capacitor\nThe UHV Capacitor is a major upgrade to power storage, providing effectively unlimited EU capacity and removing issues with the EU buffer size being too small to last through large crafts. This does mean that power production is likely to run 24/7, so players need to ensure their power and resource production can handle this. It also unlocks wireless EU between LSCs, but this is not advisable in UHV: any LSC with a UHV capacitor on wireless mode can only safely sustain 10B EU/t of output,"
- candidate `chunk-5f5916d3f672b5b9e6d815efae63cd1d` doc=doc-0acf46d9067c834f0c19087002ed00b0 words=2240-2640 distance=0.323140 similarity=0.676860 sections=[Insane Voltage (IV) > Progression Goals > Other chemical lines Insane Voltage (IV) > Progression Goals > Rockets] text="Although PBI is not strictly required in IV, it is needed for the Tier 2 Thermal Padding that almost every planet from Tier 3 and above demands, and can be used to greatly improve circuit production by making Advanced SMDs, and parallelize multiblocks with the Linked Input Bus.\nRare Earths\nThe rare earth lines are never required, beyond basic samarium processing (which is very short and easy to make, but has poor yield and no byproducts), but are useful for many otherwise rare materials. The simplest of these lines is advanced samarium processing, which greatly improves the yield from Samarium Ore Concentrate Dust and yields byproducts of Cerium, Neodymium, and Lanthanum, and can be upgraded in LuV to further double the Samarium yield. The other two rare earth lines are the Monazite Line (monaline) and the Bastnasite Line (bastline), which can convert the respective crushed ores into a variety of rare earths and other materials: Zirconium, Cerium, Lanthanum, Neodymium, Holmium, Terbium, Gadolinium, and Samarium for the Bastline, and Hafnia, Zirconium, Cerium, Europium, Gadolinium, and Samarium for the Monaline. Of these materials, only Samarium is required to enter LuV, but the others have a variety of uses in LuV and beyond. Note that all of these lines require automating the Dissolution Tank .\nRockets\nUnlike most tiers, IV contains two different tiers of rockets and associated sets of planets that they unlock. The Tier 3 Rocket is available early in the tier, only being gated behind the IV Assembling Machine to make some of the parts. The Tier 4 Rocket, on the other hand, requires the Assembly Line, meaning it is unavailable until just before the start of LuV. In addition, both tiers require an upgraded rocket fuel, Dense Hydrazine, in order to use, which will require building a Chemical Plant for players who opted to use Cetane-Boosted Diesel for the first two tiers. Most planets from Tier 3 onwards also require an upgraded set of Thermal Padding, which needs PBI to make, and the Tier 4 planet Venus requires a full set of armor with the SpaceSuit property. For a full list of resources available on the Tier 3 and 4 planets, see the Planets page. The Tier 3 rocket also unlocks the ability to make a space station over Jupiter, although the Tier 4 rocket is required to make the Planetary Gas Siphon that makes such a space station"
- candidate `chunk-1d609c84673bf3aa6d64dbcb26ae3c64` doc=doc-0b20024c57c212406bf68b660f2eaf30 words=640-1040 distance=0.340410 similarity=0.659590 sections=[Rockets > Space Travel > Launch Process Rockets > Space Travel > Moon Travel Checklist Rockets > Crafting a Tier 1 Rocket Rockets > Crafting a Tier 1 Rocket > NASA Workbench Rockets > Crafting a Tier 1 Rocket > Implosion Compressor Rockets > Crafting a Tier 1 Rocket > Storage Rockets Rockets > Crafting Tier 2+ Rockets Rockets > Rocket Fuels] text="to. The tier requirement of a launch is listed on the top of the screen; insufficient tier requirements prevent selecting a planet as a destination. The available destinations only depend on the tier of the rocket, not on the launch site.\nUpon selecting a destination, the destination will be loaded in, and the player will descend riding some form of a Lunar Lander (Parachute, Lunar Lander, Landing Balloons, etc.). For the Moon , the player must press space to expend fuel and slow down the Lunar Lander to a descent rate slower than -20m/s to prevent an explosive crash landing. Upon landing, the player can exit the Lander by sneaking. The Lunar Lander will hold the rocket (with its fuel) and launchpads, used for a return flight. Punch to break it like a boat.\nMoon Travel Checklist\nMain Article: Moon Travel Checklist\nCrafting a Tier 1 Rocket\nNASA Workbench\nThe NASA Workbench is used to make rockets and other Galacticraft vehicles. Notable crafting components used to make the NASA Workbench include an HV Assembling Machine, 2 IV Circuits, 3 EV Circuits, Energetic Alloy frame boxes, and 6 Nether Star Plates (requiring 9 Nether Stars for a Block of Nether Star).\nImplosion Compressor\nThe Implosion Compressor is required to craft Galacticraft compressed metal plates, which are used in rockets and oxygen systems.\nStorage Rockets\nIn the T1 Rocket craft, there is an optional slot below the rocket control computer to add a copper, iron, or gold chest into (these recipes are also available in NEI ). This will add storage space to the rocket, but it will not be detected by the T1 Rocket quest in the Space Race tab. These can be converted to the normal rocket in a crafting grid.\nCrafting Tier 2+ Rockets\nEntrance to a Moon Dungeon\nThe NASA Workbench requires new schematics to craft higher tiers of rockets. These schematics are found in dungeons on planets in tier order. Tier 2 rocket schematics, for example, can be found in the reward room of Moon Dungeons. Dungeon entrances are deep holes on the surface that have unnatural brick blocks on the bottom.\nThe dungeons are naturally generated and so may be difficult to find. It is important to mark the location of each dungeon found as the coordinates are the same across each planet.\nHigher tiers of rockets require different kinds of Rocket Fuels .\nRocket Fuels"
- candidate `chunk-d2c2bbcff80e355c30fdd73824e0028f` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1600-2000 distance=0.340861 similarity=0.659139 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Integrated Ore Factory Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Compact Fusion Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Fusion Reactor Mk4 Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Space Elevator Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Space Elevator > Space Mining Module MK-II Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Space Elevator > Space Assembler Module Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Infinite Fluid Drilling Rig] text="be the only ore processor in lategame bases.\nCompact Fusion\nCompact Fusion Reactors (Compacts) are advanced versions of Fusion Reactors that condense 64 regular Fusion Reactors worth of throughput into a single multiblock with the cost of 48 Fusion Reactors of their tier. Although Compacts are available as early as LuV, UHV is where regular Fusion Reactors become largely obsolete due to how much the demand for fusion products increases.\nFusion Reactor Mk4\nThe Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. Its primary advantage over previous tiers of Fusion Reactor is speed: unlike Mk2 or Mk3 Fusion Reactors, Mk4+ Fusion Reactors get 4/4 overclocks on recipes below their tier. This is still much slower than a Compact Mk3 when using the regular Mk4 Fusion Reactor, but the Compact Mk4 is a massive speed upgrade, ranging from 8 to 21 times as fast as a Compact Mk3 depending on the recipe tier.\nThe new recipes unlocked, other than a faster recipe for Molten Californium, are all for new materials: Fermium and Neptunium are used for the QFT , Rhugnor is mostly used for Hypogen, Hypogen is better produced through a loop in the DTPF , Metastable Oganesson is used for the Mk5 Fusion Reactor, Technetium Plasma is used in the Space Elevator, Bromine Plasma processes Europium and Americium combs, and Flerovium has almost no uses until UMV.\nSpace Elevator\nSpace Mining Module MK-II\nThe Mk-II space mining module is much more powerful than Mk-I, providing a significant speed improvement and access to many more asteroids with important materials. Most notably, it is an immensely better source of Cosmic Neutronium and Infinity Catalyst than anything available prior, and the only viable source for the quantities needed in UEV. It requires UEV circuits and at least Mk-II motors for the Space Elevator.\nSpace Assembler Module\nThe Space Assembler is used to craft certain items that cannot be made in conventional assemblers. Its most notable uses are for Optical Circuits in UEV, but it can be used to craft some quality of life upgrades in UHV, most notably the Advanced Stocking Input Hatch.\nInfinite Fluid Drilling Rig\nThe Infinite Fluid Drilling Rig is the best source of pumpable fluids available until the Space Elevator Pumping Module in UEV. It is much faster than the finite Fluid Drilling Rigs, and has no risk of running"
- candidate `chunk-a0b62168aaa1a29a518e66fb91bc0e9c` doc=doc-2dca4aebd2d58cec651996f808e3aec7 words=0-400 distance=0.343401 similarity=0.656599 sections=[Tier] text="GTNH is divided up into tiers. Each new tier unlocks more materials, machines, multiblocks and mods available to use. The first ten tiers up to UHV are considered fully implemented, while major changes are still in development for UEV-MAX. Tier is a common term used by many mods, to represent the player's level of progress of any sort; other tiered mechanics are listed below.\nBlood Magic Altar • Coils • Electricity • Circuits • IC2 Crops • Rockets • Thaumcraft Wands\nTier | EU [ 1 ] | Casing [ 2 ] | Materials | Coil | Glass | Dimensions\n0 Stone | Wood, Stone, Flint, Leather, Coal, Charcoal, (fuel) Coke, Copper, Tin, Lapis, Redstone, Gold, Ender Pearl, Slimeball, Sticky Resin, Glue, Iron, Wrought Iron , Glass, Bronze, Lava, Water, Soularium\n1 Steam | Bronze | Nether Quartz , Sulfur, Rubber, Red Alloy , Obzinite, Obsidian [ 3 ] , Diamond, Lead [ 4 ] , Bismuth [ 5 ] , Steel | Nether [ 6 ]\n2 LV | 32 | Steel | Oil, Seed Oil, Polyethylene, Light Fuel, Refined Glue, Advanced Glue, Hydrogen, Oxygen, Helium, Nitrogen, Lithium, Sodium, Annealed Copper, Magnalium, Cupronickel, Silver [ 7 ] , Nickel [ 7 ] , Electrum, Glowstone [ 8 ] , Zinc, Cryolite, Chlorine, Damascus Steel, Vanadium, Vanadiumsteel, Molybdenum, Vis Shards, metal blocks | Cupronickel | Twilight Forest\n3 MV | 128 | Aluminium | Redstone Alloy, Cobalt, Ardite, Thaumium, Void Metal, Manasteel, Energetic Alloy, Pulsating Iron, Dark Steel, Electrical Steel, Soularium, Chrome, Silicon Solar Grade , Kanthal, IC2 Coolant, Diesel, Benzene, Stainless Steel | Kanthal\n4 HV | 512 | Stainless Steel | Vibrant Alloy, Eye of Ender [ 9 ] , Neodymium, PTFE, Radium, Radon, Rutile, Shadow Metal, Titanium | Nichrome | Glass (vanilla) | Rocket T1 Pers. Dimension Last Millenium The End [ 6 ]\n5 EV | 2k | Titanium | Tungsten, Tungstensteel, Radon, End Steel, Crystalline Alloy, Melodic Alloy, Enderium, TPV-Alloy, HSS-G, Platinum, Iridium, Terrasteel | TPV-Alloy | Managlass Reinforced Glass TRB Glass Block [ 10 ] | Rocket T2, Spectre\n6 IV | 8k | Tungstensteel | Naquadah, Stellar Alloy, Osmium, HSS-S, Elementium, Gaia Spirit, Rhodium, Palladium | HSS-G HSS-S | Alfglass TsRB Glass Block [ 11 ] Thorium Yttrium Glass Block | Rocket T3\n7 LuV | 32k | Rhodium-Plated Palladium | Europium | Naquadah Naquadah Alloy | RPPRB Glass Block [ 12 ]"
- candidate `chunk-bceb3f14333b5086d43db76183a4dd8d` doc=doc-a509849f031bb1dadb346a8565bf75e8 words=960-1360 distance=0.343857 similarity=0.656143 sections=[Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Godforge Upgrades Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Infrastructure Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Infrastructure > Power Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Infrastructure > Power > Dyson Swarm Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Infrastructure > Power > Naquadah Fuel] text="exponential scaling and Magnetohydrodynamically Constrained Star Matter scales linearly, although the latter is not practical until UXV. Charge and Conversion can both be progressed by running as many recipes as possible, with the former benefiting from the TBF upgrade and the latter from anything that increases parallels.\nBoth of these routes will leave at least one Graviton Shard left over after completing the END upgrade. Combined with the 6 Graviton Shards that can be immediately obtained from placing a Heliofusion Exoticizer in Magmatter mode, it is possible to get the TPTP upgrade even if the player did not originally go down the right path in the upgrade tree's split. This upgrade is necessary for producing Magmatter, since some of the plasmas that the recipe can request are multi-step, and can only be made in the Plasma Fabricator.\nIn addition to Graviton Shards, many of the upgrades also require items to be inserted to complete them. The most notable costs are the Eternity and Universium needed for the last two upgrades, forcing them to be unlocked only after a tier 7 Eye of Harmony, and the 24 total UMV batteries required for all of the upgrades.\nInfrastructure\nPower\nThe Eye of Harmony is extremely power-hungry, and will likely consume most of the player's power generation while they progress through its tiers. Without any overclocks its power usage is fairly modest, on the order of 100B EU/t, but it is also extremely slow, and adding even a single overclock increases it to multiple trillion EU/t due to its very inefficient overclocks. In UMV, there are three viable sources of power to run the Eye of Harmony and its supporting infrastructure.\nDyson Swarm\nSee More: Dyson Swarm Ground Unit\nDyson Swarm Ground Units (Dysons) remain viable in UMV to power the Eye of Harmony and its supporting infrastructure, although unlike Antimatter or power EoHs, they cannot scale through UXV. The Matter Manipulator is very useful for placing large numbers of Dysons and their supporting Quantum Computers , and the Energized Wireless Dynamo Hatch can be used to avoid placing Lapotronic Supercapacitors . Completing UMV comfortably with Dysons typically requires dozens of them, and completing the tier quickly can take hundreds.\nNaquadah Fuel\nSee More: Naquadah Fuel Refinery and Large Naquadah Reactor\nNaqfuel in UMV should be built with an eye towards using depleted Naq5 or Naq6 in the SSASS , although in UMV"
- candidate `chunk-7acfdf4e68ad78cd3235f7f2a80a6893` doc=doc-a509849f031bb1dadb346a8565bf75e8 words=320-720 distance=0.344570 similarity=0.655430 sections=[Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Eye of Harmony Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Stellar Catalyst Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Godforge Upgrades] text="materials, and running parallels in the EoH, and is also usable as fuel for the Godforge. White Dwarf Matter is only produced by tier 1-tier 3 recipes, and is mainly used in tier 2-tier 4 casings. Black Dwarf Matter is similar: it is only produced by tier 4-tier 6 recipes, and mainly used in tier 5-tier 7 casings. Universium is produced by tier 7-tier 9 recipes, and is required for tier 8-tier 9 casings, but its main use is UXV components, which demand very large amounts of it.\nClimbing the tiers of the Eye of Harmony is necessary to finish UMV. The EoH has three different types of casings: spacetime compression field generators, which determine maximum recipe tier, time dilation field generators, which increase speed, and stabilisation field generators, which increase recipe success chance. Determining the best order to upgrade them is complex, but one example is listed on the Eye of Harmony's wiki page. At base speed, the EoH is incredibly slow, encouraging players to overclock it. However, the EoH has inefficient overclocks compared to most other machines (taking 8x the EU/t for 2x the speed, as compared to 4x for most machines), forcing players who want to overclock the EoH to expand their power production first. Although only a 7/x/x EoH is strictly needed to start UXV, its Universium production is unusably slow for any serious UXV crafts; a 9/9/9 EoH with Astral Arrays for parallels will be needed before UXV components become easily affordable.\nStellar Catalyst\nStellar catalyst is the fifth and final tier of DTPF catalyst, made from Stellar Plasma. Unlike the first four tiers, all of which require only plasmas that can be made in a Fusion Reactor Mk3, Stellar catalyst requires two Mk5 recipes (for Lead and Thorium Plasma) and a Plasma Fabricator recipe (for Naquadria Plasma), in addition to the Stellar Plasma. Many low-tier DTPF recipes, such as Neutronium or LuV-UV Superconductor Base, do not have Stellar catalyst variants, meaning Exotic catalyst remains useful even after Stellar catalyst can be produced in bulk. However, some materials, such as Hypogen and UHV+ Superconductor Base, do have improved Stellar variants, and Stellar catalyst is the only catalyst accepted for a few recipes, such as the direct Tesseract to Transcendent Metal recipe.\nGodforge Upgrades\nSee More: Forge of the Gods\nThe Forge of the Gods (Godforge), which was optional in UIV, is required by the end"

Most planets from Tier 3 onwards also require an upgraded set of Thermal Padding, which needs PBI to make, and the Tier 4 planet Venus requires a full set of armor with the SpaceSuit property. For a full list of resources available on the Tier 3 and 4 planets, see the Planets page. The Tier 3 rocket also unlocks the ability to make a space station over Jupiter, although the Tier 4 rocket is required to make the Planetary Gas Siphon that makes such a space station useful."

- candidate `chunk-303f0acb1197f3638b42847847bb8637` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1670-1836 distance=0.323825 similarity=0.676175 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Fusion Reactor Mk4] text="Fusion Reactor Mk4\nThe Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. - candidate `chunk-c18096e8b035aa08daa337f0ba995048` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=914-1086 distance=0.335511 similarity=0.664489 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Mothership] text="Mothership\nThe Mothership is the end of UHV progression, being required to reach Tier 9 planets and obtain Tengam, the magnetic material in UEV through UMV motors. Creating a Mothership requires launching a Shuttle Rocket while holding the necessary blocks and items, similar to a space station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar."

Rocket\nDeprecated Fuel: LMP-103S | Max. Rocket: T4\nDeprecated Fuel: Monomethlyhydrazine Fuel Mix | Max. Rocket: T6\nDeprecated Fuel: Unsymmetrical Dimethylhydrazine Fuel Mix | Max. Rocket: T8"
- candidate `chunk-dd32ee9a7437c9bdc478d307b750b39f` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=88-296 distance=0.290354 similarity=0.709646 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Progression > Tier 7 Rocket] text="Tier 7 Rocket\nThe Tier 7 Rocket is available as soon as the player is able to power their Assembly Line with two UV Energy Hatches to overclock it to UHV. It unlocks four new planets: Haumea, Makemake, Pluto, and the Kuiper Belt, which should only be mined using Void Miners at this point. The most useful planet to mine is Haumea, which has the earliest source of Nether Star Ore as well as a high chance for Infused Gold Ore, making it very useful for setting up the second tier of Naquadah Fuel. Other new ores are Borax, Red Garnet, Yellow Garnet, and Chrysotile. The available underground fluids are Hydrofluoric Acid on Makemake, and Oxygen, Nitrogen, Fluorine, and Liquid Air on Pluto.\nThe dungeons containing the next tier of schematic are found on Pluto, alongside the Draconic Core Schematic for the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter . It is highly recommended to place the Tier 8 Rocket Schematic in a singleblock Scanner (a Research Station in Scanner mode will not work) and duplicate it using a UV Circuit Assembler, because two Tier 8 Rocket Schematics will be needed: one for making the Tier 8 Rocket, and one to be researched for the Shuttle Schematic for the Mothership ."
- candidate `chunk-303f0acb1197f3638b42847847bb8637` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1670-1836 distance=0.323825 similarity=0.676175 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Fusion Reactor Mk4] text="Fusion Reactor Mk4\nThe Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. Its primary advantage over previous tiers of Fusion Reactor is speed: unlike Mk2 or Mk3 Fusion Reactors, Mk4+ Fusion Reactors get 4/4 overclocks on recipes below their tier. This is still much slower than a Compact Mk3 when using the regular Mk4 Fusion Reactor, but the Compact Mk4 is a massive speed upgrade, ranging from 8 to 21 times as fast as a Compact Mk3 depending on the recipe tier.\nThe new recipes unlocked, other than a faster recipe for Molten Californium, are all for new materials: Fermium and Neptunium are used for the QFT , Rhugnor is mostly used for Hypogen, Hypogen is better produced through a loop in the DTPF , Metastable Oganesson is used for the Mk5 Fusion Reactor, Technetium Plasma is used in the Space Elevator, Bromine Plasma processes Europium and Americium combs, and Flerovium has almost no uses until UMV."
- candidate `chunk-fc19ae52afa2b36372260d4e67bf17e2` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=945-1056 distance=0.324534 similarity=0.675466 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Tier 6 Rocket] text="Tier 6 Rocket\nThe Tier 6 Rocket can be crafted once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. There are two planets available, Proteus and Triton, both moons of Neptune. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . Deuterium and Ethylene are available as underground fluids from a Fluid Drilling Rig . The Tier 6 Rocket also unlocks the ability to make Planetary Gas Siphons above Neptune for Tritium, Helium-3, Ammonia, and Xenon."
- candidate `chunk-21a9d8773178e2e4375f6688c2c63c7e` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=65-239 distance=0.330273 similarity=0.669727 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Tier 8 Rocket] text="Tier 8 Rocket\nThis is the last regular rocket upgrade. Tier 8 plate ingots need two UHV energy hatches in the assembly line. The rocket unlocks multiple exoplanets. There is no new dungeon, the Shuttle Rocket schematic can be crafted using a schematic from a Pluto dungeon.\n- T Ceti E is required for seaweed, which is used for the new circuit line. A few stacks might be needed to extract the culture.\n- Barnarda C is the only source of Unknown Liquid before UEV, and the trees are needed to manufacture Xenoxene.\n- Vega B has Infinity Catalyst as a small ore, although meteors are an alternative that is available slightly earlier.\n- Barnarda F has Bedrockium as a small ore. While not strictly required, it is a good source for the required large-scale production.\nAwakened Draconium can be found as a small ore on four of the new planets, including Vega B and Barnarda F. Tartarite (used to produce Celestial Tungsten plasma) can be found on Barnarda C and Alpha Centauri Bb."
- candidate `chunk-c18096e8b035aa08daa337f0ba995048` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=914-1086 distance=0.335511 similarity=0.664489 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Mothership] text="Mothership\nThe Mothership is the end of UHV progression, being required to reach Tier 9 planets and obtain Tengam, the magnetic material in UEV through UMV motors. Creating a Mothership requires launching a Shuttle Rocket while holding the necessary blocks and items, similar to a space station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar."
- candidate `chunk-4972e5764551a73a3bd8e8ccd383aed3` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1088-1272 distance=0.337272 similarity=0.662728 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power Production] text="Power Production\nThe only viable power sources in UHV are Plasma and Naquadah Fuel.\nThe Tier 8 Rocket provides access to Tartarite, meaning Celestial Tungsten Plasma, the best plasma fuel in the game, is available. Plasma also benefits from new rotor materials, such as Infinity Catalyst or Infinity, that significantly improve the amount of power that can be produced from a single turbine. Compact Fusion Reactors become much more affordable in UHV as well, making Plasma significantly easier to scale.\nNaquadah Fuel gains access to the Naquadah Fuel Refinery once Bio Circuits are made. This multiblock is used to produce all tiers of Naquadah Fuel above Mk2, each of which is a significant upgrade over its predecessor. Naq3 provides over 4x the EU/t when compared to Naq2, at the cost of somewhat more Heavy Naquadah Fuel and some additives; it can also be doubled by using the Chromatic Glass recipe, but this requires large amounts of Hyper-Intensity Laser Engravers to support. Naq4 is also possible to make in UHV, if either Nano Resin, Meteors, or Depleted Thorium Fuel are used to source the Praseodymium."
- context `chunk-bd30c29740c8b96a881cb63d33fa8578` doc=doc-0acf46d9067c834f0c19087002ed00b0 words=2452-2641 text="Rockets\nUnlike most tiers, IV contains two different tiers of rockets and associated sets of planets that they unlock. The Tier 3 Rocket is available early in the tier, only being gated behind the IV Assembling Machine to make some of the parts. The Tier 4 Rocket, on the other hand, requires the Assembly Line, meaning it is unavailable until just before the start of LuV. In addition, both tiers require an upgraded rocket fuel, Dense Hydrazine, in order to use, which will require building a Chemical Plant for players who opted to use Cetane-Boosted Diesel for the first two tiers. Most planets from Tier 3 onwards also require an upgraded set of Thermal Padding, which needs PBI to make, and the Tier 4 planet Venus requires a full set of armor with the SpaceSuit property. For a full list of resources available on the Tier 3 and 4 planets, see the Planets page. The Tier 3 rocket also unlocks the ability to make a space station over Jupiter, although the Tier 4 rocket is required to make the Planetary Gas Siphon that makes such a space station useful."

Original query: Which destinations are listed for a T4 rocket, and what is the maximum rocket tier for Dense Hydrazine?
Search query: Which destinations are listed for a T4 rocket, and what is the maximum rocket tier for Dense Hydrazine?

Status: answer

Answer:

The T4 rocket lists Io, Mercury, and Venus as destinations. Dense Hydrazine has a maximum rocket tier of T4.

- candidate `chunk-dd32ee9a7437c9bdc478d307b750b39f` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=88-296 distance=0.290354 similarity=0.709646 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Progression > Tier 7 Rocket] text="Tier 7 Rocket\nThe Tier 7 Rocket is available as soon as the player is able to power their Assembly Line with two UV Energy Hatches to overclock it to UHV. It unlocks four new planets: Haumea, Makemake, Pluto, and the Kuiper Belt, which should only be mined using Void Miners at this point. Other new ores are Borax, Red Garnet, Yellow Garnet, and Chrysotile. The available underground fluids are Hydrofluoric Acid on Makemake, and Oxygen, Nitrogen, Fluorine, and Liquid Air on Pluto.\nThe dungeons containing the next tier of schematic are found on Pluto, alongside the Draconic Core Schematic for the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter . It is highly recommended to place the Tier 8 Rocket Schematic in a singleblock Scanner (a Research Station in Scanner mode will not work) and duplicate it using a UV Circuit Assembler, because two Tier 8 Rocket Schematics will be needed: one for making the Tier 8 Rocket, and one to be researched for the Shuttle Schematic for the Mothership ."
- candidate `chunk-303f0acb1197f3638b42847847bb8637` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1670-1836 distance=0.323825 similarity=0.676175 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Fusion Reactor Mk4] text="Fusion Reactor Mk4\nThe Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. Its primary advantage over previous tiers of Fusion Reactor is speed: unlike Mk2 or Mk3 Fusion Reactors, Mk4+ Fusion Reactors get 4/4 overclocks on recipes below their tier. This is still much slower than a Compact Mk3 when using the regular Mk4 Fusion Reactor, but the Compact Mk4 is a massive speed upgrade, ranging from 8 to 21 times as fast as a Compact Mk3 depending on the recipe tier.\nThe new recipes unlocked, other than a faster recipe for Molten Californium, are all for new materials: Fermium and Neptunium are used for the QFT , Rhugnor is mostly used for Hypogen, Hypogen is better produced through a loop in the DTPF , Metastable Oganesson is used for the Mk5 Fusion Reactor, Technetium Plasma is used in the Space Elevator, Bromine Plasma processes Europium and Americium combs, and Flerovium has almost no uses until UMV."
- candidate `chunk-fc19ae52afa2b36372260d4e67bf17e2` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=945-1056 distance=0.324534 similarity=0.675466 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Tier 6 Rocket] text="Tier 6 Rocket\nThe Tier 6 Rocket can be crafted once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. There are two planets available, Proteus and Triton, both moons of Neptune. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . Deuterium and Ethylene are available as underground fluids from a Fluid Drilling Rig . The Tier 6 Rocket also unlocks the ability to make Planetary Gas Siphons above Neptune for Tritium, Helium-3, Ammonia, and Xenon."
- candidate `chunk-21a9d8773178e2e4375f6688c2c63c7e` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=65-239 distance=0.330273 similarity=0.669727 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Tier 8 Rocket] text="Tier 8 Rocket\nThis is the last regular rocket upgrade. Tier 8 plate ingots need two UHV energy hatches in the assembly line. The rocket unlocks multiple exoplanets. There is no new dungeon, the Shuttle Rocket schematic can be crafted using a schematic from a Pluto dungeon.\n- T Ceti E is required for seaweed, which is used for the new circuit line. A few stacks might be needed to extract the culture.\n- Barnarda C is the only source of Unknown Liquid before UEV, and the trees are needed to manufacture Xenoxene.\n- Vega B has Infinity Catalyst as a small ore, although meteors are an alternative that is available slightly earlier.\n- Barnarda F has Bedrockium as a small ore. While not strictly required, it is a good source for the required large-scale production.\nAwakened Draconium can be found as a small ore on four of the new planets, including Vega B and Barnarda F. Tartarite (used to produce Celestial Tungsten plasma) can be found on Barnarda C and Alpha Centauri Bb."
- candidate `chunk-c18096e8b035aa08daa337f0ba995048` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=914-1086 distance=0.335511 similarity=0.664489 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Mothership] text="Mothership\nThe Mothership is the end of UHV progression, being required to reach Tier 9 planets and obtain Tengam, the magnetic material in UEV through UMV motors. Creating a Mothership requires launching a Shuttle Rocket while holding the necessary blocks and items, similar to a space station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar."
- candidate `chunk-4972e5764551a73a3bd8e8ccd383aed3` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1088-1272 distance=0.337272 similarity=0.662728 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power Production] text="Power Production\nThe only viable power sources in UHV are Plasma and Naquadah Fuel.\nThe Tier 8 Rocket provides access to Tartarite, meaning Celestial Tungsten Plasma, the best plasma fuel in the game, is available. Plasma also benefits from new rotor materials, such as Infinity Catalyst or Infinity, that significantly improve the amount of power that can be produced from a single turbine. Compact Fusion Reactors become much more affordable in UHV as well, making Plasma significantly easier to scale.\nNaquadah Fuel gains access to the Naquadah Fuel Refinery once Bio Circuits are made. This multiblock is used to produce all tiers of Naquadah Fuel above Mk2, each of which is a significant upgrade over its predecessor. Naq3 provides over 4x the EU/t when compared to Naq2, at the cost of somewhat more Heavy Naquadah Fuel and some additives; it can also be doubled by using the Chromatic Glass recipe, but this requires large amounts of Hyper-Intensity Laser Engravers to support. Naq4 is also possible to make in UHV, if either Nano Resin, Meteors, or Depleted Thorium Fuel are used to source the Praseodymium."

- candidate `chunk-fc19ae52afa2b36372260d4e67bf17e2` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=945-1056 distance=0.339454 similarity=0.660546 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Tier 6 Rocket] text="Tier 6 Rocket\nThe Tier 6 Rocket can be crafted once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . - candidate `chunk-4ebba377064a29e9d4a2afac5f24e1a7` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1058-1316 distance=0.346022 similarity=0.653978 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power Generation] text="Power Generation\nIn ZPM, most existing power generation methods from earlier tiers, such as Nitrobenzene , Rocket Fuel, and Nuclear Reactors , remain viable, but start to fall off due to increasing power demands and a lack of upgrades. One notable upgrade is Huge Turbines for all gas, steam, or plasma-based power, which are unlocked with Americium.\nPlasma, on the other hand, is still viable and will continue to be viable for many more tiers. In addition to the aforementioned Huge Turbines, plasma benefits from better fuels in the form of Tin Plasma or Runite Plasma (although the latter requires a UV Alloy Blast Smelter ), better production rates using the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, and the XL Plasma Turbine and XL Supercritical Steam Turbine to greatly improve power throughput.\nA Large Naquadah Reactor.\nZPM also unlocks one of the strongest power generation methods in the mid and late game: Naquadah Fuel, often abbreviated to Naqfuel. Power is produced by inputting Naqfuel into a Large Naquadah Reactor (LNR), alongside Liquid Air, a coolant (Gelid Cryotheum), and an excited liquid (Molten Atomic Separation Catalyst), all of which will need to be produced in large quantities by players seeking to use the fuel for power. Two tiers of Naqfuel are available in ZPM: tier 1 requires the Mk2 Fusion Reactor, while tier 2 is produced by combining tier 1 fuel with a couple other ingredients in an overclocked Mega Chemical Reactor . Each LNR can generate up to 42.9M EU/t with Naqfuel 1, and up to 101.2M EU/t with Naqfuel 2."
- candidate `chunk-21a9d8773178e2e4375f6688c2c63c7e` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=65-239 distance=0.352396 similarity=0.647604 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Tier 8 Rocket] text="Tier 8 Rocket\nThis is the last regular rocket upgrade. - candidate `chunk-281335ed0efda71a27ab652405366a1b` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=1918-2065 distance=0.355426 similarity=0.644574 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Power] text="Power\nUV is the point at which power generation from the early game falls off: Nitrobenzene, Rocket Fuel, and Nuclear Reactors can last up to this point, but should be replaced by the start of the next tier. Plasma or Naquadah Fuel, both of which are viable in UV and able to scale for multiple more tiers, should be used instead. Plasma gains access to the Fusion Reactor Mk3, which provides both access to the best plasma chain fuels and an overclock on earlier fusion recipes to reduce the need for spam, and the Stocking Input Hatch helps parallelize on slower fusion steps. It also benefits from new better turbine materials, such as Cosmic Neutronium. Naquadah Fuel also benefits from these improvements for its slow fusion step, and gains access to Haumea Void Miners , the Space Elevator, and the Mega Apiary to help source its inputs."

- context `chunk-dd32ee9a7437c9bdc478d307b750b39f` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=88-296 text="Tier 7 Rocket\nThe Tier 7 Rocket is available as soon as the player is able to power their Assembly Line with two UV Energy Hatches to overclock it to UHV. The most useful planet to mine is Haumea, which has the earliest source of Nether Star Ore as well as a high chance for Infused Gold Ore, making it very useful for setting up the second tier of Naquadah Fuel. Other new ores are Borax, Red Garnet, Yellow Garnet, and Chrysotile. The available underground fluids are Hydrofluoric Acid on Makemake, and Oxygen, Nitrogen, Fluorine, and Liquid Air on Pluto.\nThe dungeons containing the next tier of schematic are found on Pluto, alongside the Draconic Core Schematic for the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter . It is highly recommended to place the Tier 8 Rocket Schematic in a singleblock Scanner (a Research Station in Scanner mode will not work) and duplicate it using a UV Circuit Assembler, because two Tier 8 Rocket Schematics will be needed: one for making the Tier 8 Rocket, and one to be researched for the Shuttle Schematic for the Mothership ."

The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar."

- candidate `chunk-303f0acb1197f3638b42847847bb8637` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=1670-1836 distance=0.323825 similarity=0.676175 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Infrastructure Improvements > Fusion Reactor Mk4] text="Fusion Reactor Mk4\nThe Mk4 Fusion Reactor is available in UHV, although it is not necessary for any recipes until UEV. - candidate `chunk-fc19ae52afa2b36372260d4e67bf17e2` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=945-1056 distance=0.324534 similarity=0.675466 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Tier 6 Rocket] text="Tier 6 Rocket\nThe Tier 6 Rocket can be crafted once a Mk2 Fusion Reactor has been used to produce Tritanium, which is needed for the Tier 6 Heavy Duty Plate. They contain a few new ores, most notably Neutronium, Black Plutonium, Plutonium 241, Uranium 235, Niobium, and Yttrium, which can be harvested either with conventional Ore Drilling Plants or with Void Miners . Deuterium and Ethylene are available as underground fluids from a Fluid Drilling Rig . The Tier 6 Rocket also unlocks the ability to make Planetary Gas Siphons above Neptune for Tritium, Helium-3, Ammonia, and Xenon."
- candidate `chunk-21a9d8773178e2e4375f6688c2c63c7e` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=65-239 distance=0.330273 similarity=0.669727 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Tier 8 Rocket] text="Tier 8 Rocket\nThis is the last regular rocket upgrade. - candidate `chunk-c18096e8b035aa08daa337f0ba995048` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=914-1086 distance=0.335511 similarity=0.664489 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > Mothership] text="Mothership\nThe Mothership is the end of UHV progression, being required to reach Tier 9 planets and obtain Tengam, the magnetic material in UEV through UMV motors. Creating a Mothership requires launching a Shuttle Rocket while holding the necessary blocks and items, similar to a space station. The Shuttle Rocket's schematic is not found in a dungeon like previous schematics, but is instead crafted in the Assembly Line. Once the Mothership is built, engines must be placed on it and provided with fuel to travel to the Amun-Ra system, which contains the six Tier 9 planets; the only relevant to unlock UEV is Seth, which contains Tengam, as the Space Elevator is a better source of everything else on these planets. A small amount of dilithium from Neper is useful early in UEV. The Space Elevator can be used to travel to them, but only after obtaining MK-III motors, which require the DTPF. The Mothership also requires many previously optional steps in progression, such as the Nano Forge , Radox, and Kevlar."

- candidate `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 distance=0.322830 similarity=0.677170 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Infrastructure Improvements > Neutronium] text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

- candidate `chunk-24c9b99eb646ef858eb38885a0a84551` doc=doc-4f4c543e0ece55aaf03e88c75a851b04 words=54-412 distance=0.350053 similarity=0.649947 sections=[Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Tier Walkthrough > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > 1) Eternity and MHDCSM] text="1) Eternity and MHDCSM\nThe end feels near after finally reaching a 7/7/7 EOH and holding universium for the first time. Unfortunately, UXV components and a 9/9/9 EOH are still a long ways off. Tipler and Gallifreyan EOH parts are crafted with MHDCSM bolts which require a new material, eternity, and many universium nanites .\nEternity is actually very cheap to manufacture in the QFT , but it has a steep up-front cost. The recipe requires the Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst and a Chronic Singularity which take 20,736L of universium combined. Once complete, however, the catalyst lasts forever and the player no longer needs universium to craft additional Chronic Singularities. Note that eternity only has a 25% chance of being produced and should absolutely be focused with fermium and neptunium plasma to nearly triple the probability of success to 72%. Good luck.\nThe first available recipe for MHDCSM is also very expensive and the player should switch to the cheaper version using eternity nanites as soon as possible. It reduces the universium cost by 50% and does not require any BDM or WDM. Unfortunately, the cheaper recipe is rated at MAX voltage which means the player needs a 4A UXV energy hatch to overclock their EIC . That is another up-front cost totaling 21,888L of universium, and needs the END upgrade in the Godforge. See the table below for a quick cost breakdown.\nIn order to obtain enough universium for just these three components, a player needs their 7/7/7 EOH to succeed 53 times. On average, that takes 135 iterations or 111.2 hours assuming no overclocks, 70% yield, 39.5% probability of success, and a recipe length of 2,965 seconds. It is highly recommended to build a second or even third 7/7/7 EOH to cut this time down significantly. Also try using antimatter for power to overclock the EOH as much as possible.\nComponents | High-Level Cost Breakdown | Low-Level Cost Breakdown | Leftover\n1 Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst 1 Chronic Singularity 1 UXV Energy Hatch | 2 Timepieces 1 Universium Nanite 10,704L MHDCSM 1,152L Universium | 42,624L Universium 20,736L WDM 20,736L BDM | 1 Timepiece 1 Universium Nanite 816L MHDCSM"

- candidate `chunk-b5ad3cfbd938edf82ea01553ca07bf5a` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2540-2660 distance=0.363936 similarity=0.636064 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Infrastructure Improvements > UU-Matter] text="UU-Matter\nUU-Matter begins to be used for crafting in UV, and will continue to be necessary for the rest of the game, particularly for circuits, nanites, and the Space Elevator. Raw Tengam is then processed in the Magnetic Flux Exhibitor into Purified Tengam, which is the magnetic material for UEV, UIV, and UMV Electric Motors. - candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"
- context `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium\nSpace Elevator\nA Space Elevator.\nThe Space Elevator is a modular multiblock that can be made late in UV, after obtaining UHV circuits. Although it supports many different modules with various abilities, the only one obtainable in UV is the first tier of Space Mining Module, which can produce hundreds or thousands of ores per second using a non-consumed tiered mining drone, computation from a Quantum Computer , rods and drill tips of varying materials depending on the mining drone, and Helium, Bismuth, or Radon Plasma. It can also be configured to change the available ores and modify the chances of each ore being produced. Using the Space Elevator effectively requires robust ore processing, including any processing lines like the Platline or Naqline whose inputs come from ores, and sufficient automatic production of plasma and rods/drill tips of the relevant material. Although it is available in UV, it is expensive enough and available late enough in the tier that many players do not build it until UHV.\nThe Space Elevator can also be used to travel to any planet up to Tier 8, although it cannot be used to return, so it's necessary to bring a rocket or other means of teleportation to get back. This mechanic can be used to reach Tier 8 planets without the Tier 8 Rocket, and thereby gain earlier access to materials like Awakened Draconium and Infinity Catalyst. An upgrade to Tier 3 motors unlocks travel to Tier 9 planets in UIV.\nMega Apiary\nThe Mega Apiary is the endgame"
- candidate `chunk-a18470513100e5d5bd3a3c8f718df284` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=0-400 distance=0.361018 similarity=0.638982 sections=[Ore Processing Concepts Ore Processing Concepts > How To Do "Good" Ore Processing? Ore Processing Concepts > How To Do "Good" Ore Processing? > Flexible Ore Processing Concepts > How To Do "Good" Ore Processing? > Expandable] text="GTNH is all about technology (mechanical or magical). But lets face it, you won't be getting anywhere by just slapping those wooden logs together. All the metals you need have to be ripped out of the ground and processed from their useless ores into a pure form (usually dusts) for further processing. And that's why you're here.\nHow To Do \"Good\" Ore Processing?\nBauxite ore processing page accessible in NEI, showcasing various processing routes and their outputs\nAlthough there are many implementations of doing ore processing, the desired features of a \"good\" solution remain the same. These desirable characteristics are:\n- Flexible\n- Expandable\n- Unbreakable\n- High Throughput\n- Lag Friendly\n- Minimal Human Intervention\nFlexible\nOres in GT: New Horizons have multiple \" routes \" you can take which give different outputs. (See the bauxite chart to the right.) For bauxite you can take three routes (Note that these choices simply outline the basic bauxite processing and are not meant to show the \"best\" way to process bauxite, realistically you will probably want to do chembath and/or bauxite slurry):\n- Macerate -> Macerate -> Simple Wash/Centrifuge (Grossular byproduct)\n- Macerate -> Thermal Centrifuge -> Macerate (Rutile + Gallium byproduct)\n- Macerate -> Simple/Normal Wash -> Macerate -> Simple Wash/Centrifuge (Rutile + Grossular (if normal wash) byproduct)\nWhile for most bases, Rutile + Gallium Route 2 is superior, perhaps you already have automated gallium from essence berries. Then you might decide to do Route 3 instead, as it gives 2x more Rutile and therefore 2x more Titanium.\nEvery ore in the game will have a different \"optimal\" route for your run and base needs. This may also change over time. As a result, you want ore processing systems to be flexible - allowing different ores to go on different routes.\nYou also want to be able to automatically pull out things at any step of the process. For example, Rare Earths from GT++ require much higher power load, which would cause your existing macerator line to choke without modifications. You'll want to filter these out and process them in specially dedicated macerators.\nExpandable\nDepending on what batch you are processing, you may find a major bottleneck in your current system, or you simply want to replace machines with multis. This means your system must be able to expand without causing catastrophic infrastructure redesigns. Ideally you only want to change"
- candidate `chunk-c63ead563fe713652b6ae7c65fd3f3c6` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=2880-3280 distance=0.363771 similarity=0.636229 sections=[Ore Processing Concepts > EV Applied Energistics 2] text="processing Naquadria (unlocked in LuV ), processing Roquesite or pure Indium ore (extremely rare) or extraction from purified Sphalerite and Galena ores .\n- Lanthanide processing. This processing line takes in crushed Bastnasite or crushed Monazite to yield the different lanthanide elements.\nFor our purposes, we will only need 6 specific AE components in order to create a rudimentary, and yet infinitely expandable AE ore processing system:\n- ME Controller. This is basic and fundamental. You will need at least 1 to be the brains of your ore processing subnet. Each exposed face can connect to and control up to 32 other AE devices, giving our 1-block controller control over a maximum of 192 devices.\n- ME Drive. This will serve as an overflow buffer, just in case all your machines suffer maintenance issues and shutdown simultaneously.\n- ME Storage Cell. Place inside the ME Drive. You will need at least 1.\n- ME Interfaces (the full block type). These will serve as the import blocks, from which the outputs of your machines will be pushed into to enter the AE network. How many you need depends on how creative you are with your GT piping.\n- ME Storage Buses. You will need 1 for each input bus of your multiblock machines, and one extra to handle overflow (optional).\n- ME OreDictionary Filter Cards. This is the magic that makes AE amazing for ore processing. You will need at least 1 per storage bus, with some exceptions.\nNow, let's talk more about the ME OreDictionary Filter Card, or OreDict cards for short. Many GT items have an OreDictionary Name, that looks something like (item type)(name) . There are OreDict names for the ore block, each of the intermediates during the ore processing steps, and the final pure dust. Using galena as an example, they are:\n- Galena Ore. oreGalena\n- Raw Galena Ore. rawOreGalena\n- Crushed Galena Ore. crushedGalena\n- Purified Galena Ore. crushedPurifiedGalena\n- Centrifuged Galena Ore. crushedCentrifugedGalena\n- Impure Pile of Galena Dust dustImpureGalena\n- Purified Pile of Galena Dust dustPureGalena\n- Galena Dust dustGalena\nME Storage Buses attempt to push out compatible items, when immediately received by the network via either ME Interfaces or ME Import Buses, into the inventories that they face. Conventionally, these would be storage blocks like chests/drawers/barrels. But note that Input Buses also have internal inventories. Thus, when we place an OreDict card"

Fusing Celestial Tungsten requires Tartarite, so it requires either a Tier 8 Rocket or the Space Elevator in order to reach Tier 8 planets.\nFinally, there are a few new materials with no uses until later:\n- Silver Plasma is used in UHV for a new plastic, Radox Polymer.\n- Rubidium, Nickel Plasma, and Iron Plasma have no uses until UEV.\nCompact Fusion\nCompact Fusion Reactors are much larger fusion reactors that have roughly the production capacity of 64 standard reactors for the cost of 48. All five tiers of Fusion Reactor have Compact equivalents, but the Mk3 is the first one that is generally considered worth making. The Compact Fusion Reactor is fast enough to use for on-demand fusion recipes, in"

- candidate `chunk-27be4ec2aa30f8622e62a1587478255f` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=3200-3600 distance=0.370863 similarity=0.629137 sections=[Ore Processing Concepts > EV Applied Energistics 2] text="Purified Galena Ore. crushedPurifiedGalena\n- Centrifuged Galena Ore. crushedCentrifugedGalena\n- Impure Pile of Galena Dust dustImpureGalena\n- Purified Pile of Galena Dust dustPureGalena\n- Galena Dust dustGalena\nME Storage Buses attempt to push out compatible items, when immediately received by the network via either ME Interfaces or ME Import Buses, into the inventories that they face. Conventionally, these would be storage blocks like chests/drawers/barrels. But note that Input Buses also have internal inventories. Thus, when we place an OreDict card inside a ME Storage Bus facing towards an Input Bus, we have created an intelligent exporter of items!\nAnother thing to note is that the OreDict Card is capable of using a complex mix of requirements (limited to 120 characters) for the items being exported by the storage bus. Asterisks (*) serve as fuzzy placeholders, vertical bars (|) serve as OR conditionals, exclamation points (!) serve as NOT conditionals, and ampersands (&) serve as AND conditionals. The OreDict card does not support parenthesis.\nFor our purposes we will want the following definitions inside our ME Storage Buses, based on the machines they are facing. The brackets themselves are not required for the OreDict definitions.\n- To Macerators: crushedCentrifuged* | rawOre* & !rawOreOilsands & !rawOreBlackgraniteOilsands This means Ores OR Centrifuged Ores AND exclude Ore Oilsands, which cannot be macerated. This enables initial maceration of whole ores (from VMs) and maceration of centrifuged ores (from LTRs) to recover tertiary byproducts.\n- To OWPs: crushed* & !crushedPurified* & !crushedCentrifuged* &!crushedBastnasite & !crushedMonazite This means Crushed Ores that are NOT Purified and are NOT Centrifuged, as well as NOT Crushed Bastnasite and NOT Crushed Monazite This is needed because (crushed*) by itself also encompasses crushed, purified AND centrifuged ores due to the ways they are oredicted. The crushed Bastnasite and Monazite ores go into lanthanide processing.\n- To LTRs: crushedPurified* & !*Galena* & !*Sphalerite* This means Purified Ores that are NOT containing Galena AND are NOT containing Sphalerite in their names. This is needed as we want to export these 2 specific purified ores for indium processing later.\n- To Large Sifters: There are 2 strategies you can use. For either of them you need to increase the priority of the storage buses to be significantly higher than those on the LTRs as purified ores that can be sifted may be sent to the LTRs instead of the Large Sifters if you don't change"
- context `chunk-4c6f550f87de6e696b0751f7826fefc3` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=3520-3920 text="are NOT containing Sphalerite in their names. This is needed as we want to export these 2 specific purified ores for indium processing later.\n- To Large Sifters: There are 2 strategies you can use. For either of them you need to increase the priority of the storage buses to be significantly higher than those on the LTRs as purified ores that can be sifted may be sent to the LTRs instead of the Large Sifters if you don't change the priority. You must also have enough/fast enough sifters to keep up with your your input or sift-able ores will overflow into the LTRs.\n- On the storage bus, use capacity cards and manually specify each item you wish to sift. You can pull these from NEI, make sure to use the proper version of the ore: ie purified certus quartz, not crushed.\n- Have no filter on the storage bus and use a screwdriver to turn on the Input Filter on the input buses on the large sifters. This setting prevents any items that don't have recipes from being inserted into the bus, thus combined with the higher priority of the bus will result in sifting anything that can be.\n- To Industrial Centrifuges: dustImpure* This means that any impure dusts will be centrifuged.\n- 3 storage buses are required to output from the Ore-proc Subnet:\n- crushedPurifiedGalena | crushedPurifiedSphalerite (external processing)\n- crushedBastnasite | crushedMonazite (external lanthanide processing)\n- *dust* & !dustImpure* & !dustPure* | *gem* (desired products)\nThus, to setup an AE-compatible system, we will do the following.\n- Place down a ME Controller and ME Drive (with storage cell inside). Ensure that power is being adequately fed into the network.\n- Setup an Input. This must push the ores/crushed ores into the network, to trigger the export function of the ME Storage Buses. There are various ways to do this, depending on how the ores are sourced, including using GT pipes and conveyors to pull from an Ender Chest or pushing directly into the network by linking a Quantum Ring.\n- Setup the ME Storage Buses with OreDict Cards. Using the appropriate definitions above, hook up your multiblock machines to the network.\n- Setup the ME Interfaces to collect back the outputs from the multiblock machines. No extra fiddling with the interfaces is required besides initial placement and hooking up to the network. For the player"
- context `chunk-5f13f1f234236c943e13b70a08107620` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=640-1040 text="Expandable: S | Unbreakable: A | High Throughput: B | Low Lag: A | Minimal Intervention: S\nOre Processing Design: Applied Energistics 2 | Tech Tier: EV | Flexible: SS | Expandable: SS | Unbreakable: S | High Throughput: Setup Dependent | Low Lag: S | Minimal Intervention: S\nOre Processing Design: Ore Processing Multi | Tech Tier: ZPM | Flexible: ? | Expandable: ? | Unbreakable: ? | High Throughput: S | Low Lag: ? | Minimal Intervention: ?\nFilter Options\nplaceholder\nSpecial Processes\nSome ores may have unique methods that can be used to obtain alternative, rare, minerals, or can extract more minerals per input ore.\nOre | Outputs | Notes\nOre: Chalcopyrite | Outputs: Platinum | Notes: Dissolve purified ore in chemical reactor to get platinum concentrate, replacing or supplementing the use of platinum metallic powder dust in the platline. You won't get copper from this.\nOre: Tetrahedrite | Outputs: Platinum | Notes: Dissolve purified ore in chemical reactor to get platinum concentrate, replacing or supplementing the use of platinum metallic powder dust in the platline. You won't get copper from this.\nOre: Ilmenite | Outputs: Niobium, Tantalum | Notes: Chemical bath purified ilmenite to get slag, which can be centrifuged.\nOre: Galena + Sphalerite | Outputs: Indium | Notes: N/A\nOre: Bauxite | Outputs: Rutile | Notes: Make bauxite slurry. Probably more efficient than regular processing line.\nOre: Pitchblende | Outputs: Radium-226 Dust | Notes: Purified pitchblende can be sifted for radium dust. Don't lick it.\nOre: Uraninite | Outputs: Radium-226 Dust | Notes: Purified uraninite can be sifted for radium dust.\nOre: Nickel | Outputs: Platinum | Notes: If you have spare mercury, you can chemical bath crushed nickel for extra platinum. Produces purified nickel ore as well.\nLV GregTech Item Pipes + Type Filters\nAutomated ore processing is possible as early as LV because of the introduction of GregTech's Item Pipes and Filter blocks. The item pipes are extremely limited compared to future tiers' logistics solutions, but they have some key properties that make them usable for automation, while having major caveats:\n- The flow of items within a network of pipes can be in any direction.\n- Items put into a pipe network are pushed into the \"closest\" inventory that accepts them.\n- Distance is measured by routing value, where higher routing value means higher distance.\n- The distances of inventories can be"
- context `chunk-794a586a0993f64266bba06805c40308` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=3200-3600 text="a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium\nSpace Elevator\nA Space Elevator.\nThe Space Elevator is a modular multiblock that can be made late in UV, after obtaining UHV circuits. Although it supports many different modules with various abilities, the only one obtainable in UV is the first tier of Space Mining Module, which can produce hundreds or thousands of ores per second using a non-consumed tiered mining drone, computation from a Quantum Computer , rods and drill tips of varying materials depending on the mining drone, and Helium, Bismuth, or Radon Plasma. It can also be configured to change the available ores and modify the chances of each ore being produced. Using the Space Elevator effectively requires robust ore processing, including any processing lines like the Platline or Naqline whose inputs come from ores, and sufficient automatic production of plasma and rods/drill tips of the relevant material. Although it is available in UV, it is expensive enough and available late enough in the tier that many players do not build it until UHV.\nThe Space Elevator can also be used to travel to any planet up to Tier 8, although it cannot be used to return, so it's necessary to bring a rocket or other means of teleportation to get back. This mechanic can be used to reach Tier 8 planets without the Tier 8 Rocket, and thereby gain earlier access to materials like Awakened Draconium and Infinity Catalyst. An upgrade to Tier 3 motors unlocks travel to Tier 9 planets in UIV.\nMega Apiary\nThe Mega Apiary is the endgame"
