- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"

- candidate `chunk-14b5590d4964f076450f6b9053e0e56a` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=3544-3944 distance=0.344653 similarity=0.655347 sections=[Ore Processing Concepts > EV Applied Energistics 2] text="- To Large Sifters: There are 2 strategies you can use. For either of them you need to increase the priority of the storage buses to be significantly higher than those on the LTRs as purified ores that can be sifted may be sent to the LTRs instead of the Large Sifters if you don't change the priority. You must also have enough/fast enough sifters to keep up with your your input or sift-able ores will overflow into the LTRs.\n- On the storage bus, use capacity cards and manually specify each item you wish to sift. You can pull these from NEI, make sure to use the proper version of the ore: ie purified certus quartz, not crushed.\n- Have no filter on the storage bus and use a screwdriver to turn on the Input Filter on the input buses on the large sifters. This setting prevents any items that don't have recipes from being inserted into the bus, thus combined with the higher priority of the bus will result in sifting anything that can be.\n- To Industrial Centrifuges: dustImpure* This means that any impure dusts will be centrifuged.\n- 3 storage buses are required to output from the Ore-proc Subnet:\n- crushedPurifiedGalena | crushedPurifiedSphalerite (external processing)\n- crushedBastnasite | crushedMonazite (external lanthanide processing)\n- *dust* & !dustImpure* & !dustPure* | *gem* (desired products)\nThus, to setup an AE-compatible system, we will do the following.\n- Place down a ME Controller and ME Drive (with storage cell inside). Ensure that power is being adequately fed into the network.\n- Setup an Input. This must push the ores/crushed ores into the network, to trigger the export function of the ME Storage Buses. There are various ways to do this, depending on how the ores are sourced, including using GT pipes and conveyors to pull from an Ender Chest or pushing directly into the network by linking a Quantum Ring.\n- Setup the ME Storage Buses with OreDict Cards. Using the appropriate definitions above, hook up your multiblock machines to the network.\n- Setup the ME Interfaces to collect back the outputs from the multiblock machines. No extra fiddling with the interfaces is required besides initial placement and hooking up to the network. For the player on a channel budget, you can use GT pipes with large throughputs (platinum or quantium) to funnel outputs from multiple output buses into a"
- candidate `chunk-24c9b99eb646ef858eb38885a0a84551` doc=doc-4f4c543e0ece55aaf03e88c75a851b04 words=54-412 distance=0.350053 similarity=0.649947 sections=[Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Tier Walkthrough > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > 1) Eternity and MHDCSM] text="1) Eternity and MHDCSM\nThe end feels near after finally reaching a 7/7/7 EOH and holding universium for the first time. Unfortunately, UXV components and a 9/9/9 EOH are still a long ways off. Tipler and Gallifreyan EOH parts are crafted with MHDCSM bolts which require a new material, eternity, and many universium nanites .\nEternity is actually very cheap to manufacture in the QFT , but it has a steep up-front cost. The recipe requires the Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst and a Chronic Singularity which take 20,736L of universium combined. Once complete, however, the catalyst lasts forever and the player no longer needs universium to craft additional Chronic Singularities. Note that eternity only has a 25% chance of being produced and should absolutely be focused with fermium and neptunium plasma to nearly triple the probability of success to 72%. Good luck.\nThe first available recipe for MHDCSM is also very expensive and the player should switch to the cheaper version using eternity nanites as soon as possible. It reduces the universium cost by 50% and does not require any BDM or WDM. Unfortunately, the cheaper recipe is rated at MAX voltage which means the player needs a 4A UXV energy hatch to overclock their EIC . That is another up-front cost totaling 21,888L of universium, and needs the END upgrade in the Godforge. See the table below for a quick cost breakdown.\nIn order to obtain enough universium for just these three components, a player needs their 7/7/7 EOH to succeed 53 times. On average, that takes 135 iterations or 111.2 hours assuming no overclocks, 70% yield, 39.5% probability of success, and a recipe length of 2,965 seconds. It is highly recommended to build a second or even third 7/7/7 EOH to cut this time down significantly. Also try using antimatter for power to overclock the EOH as much as possible.\nComponents | High-Level Cost Breakdown | Low-Level Cost Breakdown | Leftover\n1 Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst 1 Chronic Singularity 1 UXV Energy Hatch | 2 Timepieces 1 Universium Nanite 10,704L MHDCSM 1,152L Universium | 42,624L Universium 20,736L WDM 20,736L BDM | 1 Timepiece 1 Universium Nanite 816L MHDCSM"

- candidate `chunk-b5ad3cfbd938edf82ea01553ca07bf5a` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2540-2660 distance=0.363936 similarity=0.636064 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Infrastructure Improvements > UU-Matter] text="UU-Matter\nUU-Matter begins to be used for crafting in UV, and will continue to be necessary for the rest of the game, particularly for circuits, nanites, and the Space Elevator. In order to obtain it in large quantities, the new Matter Fabrication CPU should be used once the player has a Quantum Anomaly to use to craft it. It has a free EU discount compared to its singleblock equivalent, access to parallels in addition to the existing perfect overclock all Mass Fabricators have, and the ability to use multiple Energy Hatches to scale better. It can also be used to produce Scrap and UU-Amplifier, but this is generally not as effective as overclocking more or placing more Matter Fabrication CPUs."

- candidate `chunk-6bebc7c1c54fce837efb57613020c769` doc=doc-c9afb2e028c318ddc2f228663f5523fe words=86-160 distance=0.365140 similarity=0.634860 sections=[Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Progression > Tengam] text="Tengam\nThe first step in UEV progression is using the Mothership to travel to Seth , which is the only planet where Raw Tengam Ore can be found. Raw Tengam is then processed in the Magnetic Flux Exhibitor into Purified Tengam, which is the magnetic material for UEV, UIV, and UMV Electric Motors. Once the player obtains their first Purified Tengam, they can make a Tengam Electromagnet, which greatly speeds up the separation process."
- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"
- context `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

- candidate `chunk-b5ad3cfbd938edf82ea01553ca07bf5a` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2540-2660 distance=0.363936 similarity=0.636064 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Infrastructure Improvements > UU-Matter] text="UU-Matter\nUU-Matter begins to be used for crafting in UV, and will continue to be necessary for the rest of the game, particularly for circuits, nanites, and the Space Elevator. In order to obtain it in large quantities, the new Matter Fabrication CPU should be used once the player has a Quantum Anomaly to use to craft it. It has a free EU discount compared to its singleblock equivalent, access to parallels in addition to the existing perfect overclock all Mass Fabricators have, and the ability to use multiple Energy Hatches to scale better. It can also be used to produce Scrap and UU-Amplifier, but this is generally not as effective as overclocking more or placing more Matter Fabrication CPUs."

- candidate `chunk-6bebc7c1c54fce837efb57613020c769` doc=doc-c9afb2e028c318ddc2f228663f5523fe words=86-160 distance=0.365140 similarity=0.634860 sections=[Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Progression > Tengam] text="Tengam\nThe first step in UEV progression is using the Mothership to travel to Seth , which is the only planet where Raw Tengam Ore can be found. Raw Tengam is then processed in the Magnetic Flux Exhibitor into Purified Tengam, which is the magnetic material for UEV, UIV, and UMV Electric Motors. Once the player obtains their first Purified Tengam, they can make a Tengam Electromagnet, which greatly speeds up the separation process."
- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"
- context `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."
- context `chunk-cbb24a351f234cec6664e9144021bcdc` doc=doc-c9afb2e028c318ddc2f228663f5523fe words=160-288 text="Waterline\nLike LuV , ZPM , and UV , UEV brings two new steps to the Waterline , one of which is required in the tier and one of which is not required until the next tier but increases yield of components for optical circuits. The Residual Decontaminant Degasser Purification Unit and its associated Grade 7 water are needed to process Optically Enriched Crystalline Boules to make UIV circuits. After making the DTPF , the Absolute Baryonic Perfection Purification Unit and its Grade 8 water and Stabilised Baryonic Matter can increase the yield of raw optical enhanced chips by 2.25x per boule over Grade 7, and are required for Dimensionally Shifted Superfluid, which is used in many recipes beginning at UIV.\nThe Degasser, used for grade 7 water"
- context `chunk-14b5590d4964f076450f6b9053e0e56a` doc=doc-10abece1affc7c7ad6fb4e0605bf710b words=3544-3944 text="- To Large Sifters: There are 2 strategies you can use. For either of them you need to increase the priority of the storage buses to be significantly higher than those on the LTRs as purified ores that can be sifted may be sent to the LTRs instead of the Large Sifters if you don't change the priority. You must also have enough/fast enough sifters to keep up with your your input or sift-able ores will overflow into the LTRs.\n- On the storage bus, use capacity cards and manually specify each item you wish to sift. You can pull these from NEI, make sure to use the proper version of the ore: ie purified certus quartz, not crushed.\n- Have no filter on the storage bus and use a screwdriver to turn on the Input Filter on the input buses on the large sifters. This setting prevents any items that don't have recipes from being inserted into the bus, thus combined with the higher priority of the bus will result in sifting anything that can be.\n- To Industrial Centrifuges: dustImpure* This means that any impure dusts will be centrifuged.\n- 3 storage buses are required to output from the Ore-proc Subnet:\n- crushedPurifiedGalena | crushedPurifiedSphalerite (external processing)\n- crushedBastnasite | crushedMonazite (external lanthanide processing)\n- *dust* & !dustImpure* & !dustPure* | *gem* (desired products)\nThus, to setup an AE-compatible system, we will do the following.\n- Place down a ME Controller and ME Drive (with storage cell inside). Ensure that power is being adequately fed into the network.\n- Setup an Input. This must push the ores/crushed ores into the network, to trigger the export function of the ME Storage Buses. There are various ways to do this, depending on how the ores are sourced, including using GT pipes and conveyors to pull from an Ender Chest or pushing directly into the network by linking a Quantum Ring.\n- Setup the ME Storage Buses with OreDict Cards. Using the appropriate definitions above, hook up your multiblock machines to the network.\n- Setup the ME Interfaces to collect back the outputs from the multiblock machines. No extra fiddling with the interfaces is required besides initial placement and hooking up to the network. For the player on a channel budget, you can use GT pipes with large throughputs (platinum or quantium) to funnel outputs from multiple output buses into a"

- candidate `chunk-24c9b99eb646ef858eb38885a0a84551` doc=doc-4f4c543e0ece55aaf03e88c75a851b04 words=54-412 distance=0.350053 similarity=0.649947 sections=[Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Tier Walkthrough > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > 1) Eternity and MHDCSM] text="1) Eternity and MHDCSM\nThe end feels near after finally reaching a 7/7/7 EOH and holding universium for the first time. Unfortunately, UXV components and a 9/9/9 EOH are still a long ways off. Tipler and Gallifreyan EOH parts are crafted with MHDCSM bolts which require a new material, eternity, and many universium nanites .\nEternity is actually very cheap to manufacture in the QFT , but it has a steep up-front cost. The recipe requires the Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst and a Chronic Singularity which take 20,736L of universium combined. Once complete, however, the catalyst lasts forever and the player no longer needs universium to craft additional Chronic Singularities. Note that eternity only has a 25% chance of being produced and should absolutely be focused with fermium and neptunium plasma to nearly triple the probability of success to 72%. Good luck.\nThe first available recipe for MHDCSM is also very expensive and the player should switch to the cheaper version using eternity nanites as soon as possible. It reduces the universium cost by 50% and does not require any BDM or WDM. Unfortunately, the cheaper recipe is rated at MAX voltage which means the player needs a 4A UXV energy hatch to overclock their EIC . That is another up-front cost totaling 21,888L of universium, and needs the END upgrade in the Godforge. See the table below for a quick cost breakdown.\nIn order to obtain enough universium for just these three components, a player needs their 7/7/7 EOH to succeed 53 times. On average, that takes 135 iterations or 111.2 hours assuming no overclocks, 70% yield, 39.5% probability of success, and a recipe length of 2,965 seconds. It is highly recommended to build a second or even third 7/7/7 EOH to cut this time down significantly. Also try using antimatter for power to overclock the EOH as much as possible.\nComponents | High-Level Cost Breakdown | Low-Level Cost Breakdown | Leftover\n1 Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst 1 Chronic Singularity 1 UXV Energy Hatch | 2 Timepieces 1 Universium Nanite 10,704L MHDCSM 1,152L Universium | 42,624L Universium 20,736L WDM 20,736L BDM | 1 Timepiece 1 Universium Nanite 816L MHDCSM"

- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"
- context `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

Unfortunately, UXV components and a 9/9/9 EOH are still a long ways off. Tipler and Gallifreyan EOH parts are crafted with MHDCSM bolts which require a new material, eternity, and many universium nanites .\nEternity is actually very cheap to manufacture in the QFT , but it has a steep up-front cost. The recipe requires the Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst and a Chronic Singularity which take 20,736L of universium combined. Once complete, however, the catalyst lasts forever and the player no longer needs universium to craft additional Chronic Singularities. Note that eternity only has a 25% chance of being produced and should absolutely be focused with fermium and neptunium plasma to nearly triple the probability of success to 72%. That is another up-front cost totaling 21,888L of universium, and needs the END upgrade in the Godforge. See the table below for a quick cost breakdown.\nIn order to obtain enough universium for just these three components, a player needs their 7/7/7 EOH to succeed 53 times. On average, that takes 135 iterations or 111.2 hours assuming no overclocks, 70% yield, 39.5% probability of success, and a recipe length of 2,965 seconds. It is highly recommended to build a second or even third 7/7/7 EOH to cut this time down significantly. Also try using antimatter for power to overclock the EOH as much as possible.\nComponents | High-Level Cost Breakdown | Low-Level Cost Breakdown | Leftover\n1 Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst 1 Chronic Singularity 1 UXV Energy Hatch | 2 Timepieces 1 Universium Nanite 10,704L MHDCSM 1,152L Universium | 42,624L Universium 20,736L WDM 20,736L BDM | 1 Timepiece 1 Universium Nanite 816L MHDCSM"

Cables will push power in the following priority:\n- Down\n- Up\n- North\n- South\n- West\n- East\nWhen producing power, each generator will always attempt to empty all of its internal buffer at once. This can cause one generator in a cable network to use fuel more rapidly than another, with order depending on tile entity processing and changing on chunk reloads.\nAll GT Cables have a max Voltage, max Amperage and a Loss/Meter/Ampere, indicated on their tooltip:\n- Cables which receive amps containing more EU than their maximum Voltage will catch fire and melt.\n- Cables that have more amps travelling through them than their maximum Amperage limit will catch fire and melt. Note that machines can request more Amperage than strictly required by their active recipe.\n- Each energy packet travelling through a cable loses Voltage per block travelled. The amount of EU lost is indicated by the Loss/Meter/Ampere number.\nEach Material has 1x, 2x, 4x, 8x, 12x, and 16x uninsulated Wires. Most of these have cable variants, except for the superconductor wires, as well as graphene, Ichorium, hypogen, Black Plutonium, Awakened Draconium, Infinity, and SpaceTime wires. Note that Uninsulated Wires have twice the Loss/Meter/Ampere as Insulated Cables. The only exceptions to this are Red alloy and Redstone alloy (as their cables are lossless, while the wires are not), Quantium, Lumiium, and Signalium (four times the loss when uninsulated), and Bedrockium (8x loss when uninsulated).\nFor example:\n- A 1x Tin Cable can handle 1A containing 32EU at a loss of 1 EU-Volt/Meter/Ampere. This means that 1 amp can travel 32 blocks before it dies.\n- A 1x Tin Wire can handle 1A containing 32EU at a loss of 2 EU-Volt/Meter/Ampere. In this case, the amp can travel 16 blocks only.\nBelow is a table of the current properties of various types of cables in GregTech: Note: In 2.8.0, many cables received maximum amperage and loss changes. This table is accurate as of version 2.8.1+.\nMaterial | Max Voltage [ 1 ] | Amp [ 2 ] | Loss [ 3 ] | Decay [ 4 ]\nMaterial: Tin | Max Voltage [ 1 ]: LV (32) | Amp [ 2 ]: 1 | Loss [ 3 ]: 1 | Decay ["

It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"

- candidate `chunk-24c9b99eb646ef858eb38885a0a84551` doc=doc-4f4c543e0ece55aaf03e88c75a851b04 words=54-412 distance=0.350053 similarity=0.649947 sections=[Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Tier Walkthrough > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > Extended Mega Ultimate Voltage (UXV) > 1) Eternity and MHDCSM] text="1) Eternity and MHDCSM\nThe end feels near after finally reaching a 7/7/7 EOH and holding universium for the first time. Unfortunately, UXV components and a 9/9/9 EOH are still a long ways off. Tipler and Gallifreyan EOH parts are crafted with MHDCSM bolts which require a new material, eternity, and many universium nanites .\nEternity is actually very cheap to manufacture in the QFT , but it has a steep up-front cost. The recipe requires the Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst and a Chronic Singularity which take 20,736L of universium combined. Once complete, however, the catalyst lasts forever and the player no longer needs universium to craft additional Chronic Singularities. Note that eternity only has a 25% chance of being produced and should absolutely be focused with fermium and neptunium plasma to nearly triple the probability of success to 72%. Good luck.\nThe first available recipe for MHDCSM is also very expensive and the player should switch to the cheaper version using eternity nanites as soon as possible. It reduces the universium cost by 50% and does not require any BDM or WDM. Unfortunately, the cheaper recipe is rated at MAX voltage which means the player needs a 4A UXV energy hatch to overclock their EIC . That is another up-front cost totaling 21,888L of universium, and needs the END upgrade in the Godforge. See the table below for a quick cost breakdown.\nIn order to obtain enough universium for just these three components, a player needs their 7/7/7 EOH to succeed 53 times. On average, that takes 135 iterations or 111.2 hours assuming no overclocks, 70% yield, 39.5% probability of success, and a recipe length of 2,965 seconds. It is highly recommended to build a second or even third 7/7/7 EOH to cut this time down significantly. Also try using antimatter for power to overclock the EOH as much as possible.\nComponents | High-Level Cost Breakdown | Low-Level Cost Breakdown | Leftover\n1 Temporal Harmonizer Catalyst 1 Chronic Singularity 1 UXV Energy Hatch | 2 Timepieces 1 Universium Nanite 10,704L MHDCSM 1,152L Universium | 42,624L Universium 20,736L WDM 20,736L BDM | 1 Timepiece 1 Universium Nanite 816L MHDCSM"

- candidate `chunk-b5ad3cfbd938edf82ea01553ca07bf5a` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2540-2660 distance=0.363936 similarity=0.636064 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Infrastructure Improvements > UU-Matter] text="UU-Matter\nUU-Matter begins to be used for crafting in UV, and will continue to be necessary for the rest of the game, particularly for circuits, nanites, and the Space Elevator. - candidate `chunk-6bebc7c1c54fce837efb57613020c769` doc=doc-c9afb2e028c318ddc2f228663f5523fe words=86-160 distance=0.365140 similarity=0.634860 sections=[Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Progression > Tengam] text="Tengam\nThe first step in UEV progression is using the Mothership to travel to Seth , which is the only planet where Raw Tengam Ore can be found. Raw Tengam is then processed in the Magnetic Flux Exhibitor into Purified Tengam, which is the magnetic material for UEV, UIV, and UMV Electric Motors. Once the player obtains their first Purified Tengam, they can make a Tengam Electromagnet, which greatly speeds up the separation process."
- candidate `chunk-5fa0554b5618150260f8ebe3b17c1882` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=2965-3345 distance=0.365871 similarity=0.634129 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Sidequests > Nano Forge and Nano Resin] text="Nano Forge and Nano Resin\nThe Nano Forge is a very large multiblock used to fabricate various tiers of nanites; it can be crafted in UV, but is not required until UHV. Crafting and running it requires 18 Carbon Nanites to be made using the much more expensive Assembly Line recipe: 1 to scan for the Data Stick, 16 to make the controller, and 1 to place inside the controller once it is built. The tier of the Nano Forge is determined by both the structure and the nanite placed inside the controller; it is possible to build the Tier 3 structure immediately, but actually upgrading to that tier is not possible until UEV . The Tier 2 is possible to build in UV with a Quantum Anomaly for the Neutronium Nanites, but provides no benefit other than perfect overclocks on Tier 1 recipes.\nThe main use for the Nano Forge in UV is for Nano Resin, a new way to produce desired lanthanides extremely easily from any lanthanide ore. A Nano Resin for a supported element can be made by combining one dust of that element with P-507 and Carbon Nanites. Each Nano Resin can be reused infinitely. In order to extract elements using it, the first step is to place a lanthanide crushed ore or ore concentrate dust in the Digester to get [Element] Chloride Concentrate. This first intermediate must be extracted using a Nano Resin matching the element of the ore, producing a Filled [Element] Extracting Nano Resin. By electrolyzing the filled Nano Resin, the Chlorine and original Nano Resin are recovered, and the lanthanide is obtained in molten form. In addition, extracting the element via Nano Resin leaves Chlorinated Rare Earth Concentrate, which can be processed by any Nano Resin, regardless of what the original ore was. This can be done for two more steps, for Chlorinated Rare Earth Enriched Solution and Chlorinated Rare Earth Diluted Solution, and it's possible to use the same Nano Resin for multiple steps, making Nano Resin a very strong source of lanthanide elements. The available elements from Nano Resin are:\n- Cerium\n- Dysprosium\n- Erbium\n- Europium\n- Gadolinium\n- Holmium\n- Lanthanum\n- Lutetium\n- Neodymium\n- Praseodymium\n- Promethium\n- Samarium\n- Terbium\n- Thulium\n- Ytterbium"
- context `chunk-48ef13f5915ef08f42de9de271e7ff30` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=1786-1940 text="Neutronium\nNeutronium is a new material that is needed in very large quantities in UV and UHV for components and other machines, and it is extremely slow to smelt, taking over two minutes at UV even with the best possible noble gas, and closer to three or four with worse ones. Because of how slow it is and how much it is used, most players passive it, setting up either a Mega Electric Blast Furnace (MEBF) or a large Volcanus array dedicated to passively smelting Neutronium Ingots. The MEBF can be scaled more easily and is much simpler to set up, but due to the high voltage and heat requirements for the Neutronium recipe and the 120% speed bonus of the Volcanus, the latter is more efficient. It is also possible to smelt Neutronium entirely on demand, but doing so requires extremely robust smelting and freezing capacity, or it will be a massive bottleneck."

- candidate `chunk-fb8dd0cda6672ae08334b16c905cb707` doc=doc-626c925b618145e4e43655f7673b36b4 words=1280-1680 distance=0.381021 similarity=0.618979 sections=[Low Voltage (LV) > Energy Conversion > IC2 EU Low Voltage (LV) > Energy Conversion > GT EU to Others Low Voltage (LV) > Revisiting Steam Low Voltage (LV) > Revisiting Steam > Steam Power Upgrades Low Voltage (LV) > Revisiting Steam > Revisiting Multiblocks Low Voltage (LV) > Progression] text="32EU, and thus require at least x2 cable.\nGT EU to Others\nGT Cables can be attached to almost any machine that requires some kind of energy, allowing a single power network to run machines from most mods in the pack including IC2, EnderIO, Forestry, Railcraft, Galacticraft and more. Look into powering it with a semifluid generator directly with creosote, its a bit more power efficient and saves on pipe distance in most builds. You can try and breed the bonsais for max stats but that won't be necessary, even one 11x11 layer of 1/1/1 bonsais will provide more than enough wood for a max size RC Boiler . Speaking of RC boilers, the tank recipe gets substantially cheaper in LV, with the screw requirement being dropped with the assembler; the casing required for the tanks can also be made cheaper by utilising the Bender and the Cutting Machine.\nAfter visiting the Twilight Forest, the player can utilise the lead found to make Potin fluid pipes, which offer substantially more throughput than Bronze pipes of the same size. You can utilise the Fluid Extractor and Solidifier to produce pipes substantially quicker than with the Bender.\nRevisiting Multiblocks\nSteam Multiblocks are made substantially cheaper in LV with the Bender and Assembler, most of these multiblocks are not superseded until HV or later so it is well worth the investment to build them. After unlocking the EBF, Steel production is trivialised and the player should consider upgrading Steam Multiblocks accordingly for a speed upgrade. If you are having issues getting enough oxygen, electrolysing Magnetite and Limonite ores should get the player through to MV.\nProgression\nProgression to MV requires the player to obtain 3 essential"

- candidate `chunk-a38a65939b58ff5649019729f9c38168` doc=doc-d8847ae5c01144e82bc225fe54375054 words=0-400 distance=0.416760 similarity=0.583240 sections=[Zero Point Module (ZPM) Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Waterline Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Naquadah Line Zero Point Module (ZPM) > Progression > Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit] text="Zero Point Voltage (ZPM) is the seventh electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. This tier is largely centered around building the infrastructure necessary to construct the next tier of Fusion Reactor, which is necessary for progression into UV. In addition, this tier introduces TecTech, the source of many late game multi-blocks. It also sees additional power generation with the availability of the Large Naquadah Reactor and MK2 Fusion Controller, and a new source of resources in the Void Miner . However, similar to LuV, material costs and processing requirements continue to rise and so infrastructure such as a Mega Electric Blast Furnace , Mega Vacuum Freezer , and Mega Chemical Reactor may be necessary. Circuits get a major improvement with the addition of Europium-doped wafers. The PCB Factory is also build-able at this stage, though its quest is UV. ZPM is generally considered to mark the transition from midgame to lategame.\nProgression\nWaterline\nNew water grades for the Waterline are now mandatory to cut and use Europium doped wafers. These wafers can be used to improve circuit production, but their main use is for ZPM Energy Hatches and Dynamo Hatches, which require NPIC wafers that can only be made from Europium or better wafers. Grade 3 water is the minimum needed, though grade 4 provides a speed boost, and will be required in UV as an ingredient in grade 5.\nNaquadah Line\nAlthough the Naquadah portion of the Naqline was already required in LuV, the portions for Enriched Naquadah and Naquadria become required in ZPM. Both are significantly shorter than the Naquadah portion; combined, they have roughly the same number of steps as Naquadah does. The full Naqline is required to progress further into ZPM, as both Enriched Naquadah and Naquadria are used to make the HIP Unit. These portions also have useful byproducts: Enriched Naquadah yields Trinium, and Naquadria produces Indium.\nHot Isostatic Pressurization Unit\nA HIP Unit.\nThe Hot Isostatic Pressurization Unit (HIP Unit) is an upgraded version of the Large Electric Compressor that is both unlocked and required in ZPM. It can run regular Compressor recipes quicker and more efficiently, and it has the ability to make Superdense Plates from most materials, which are required in many recipes in ZPM and onwards, such as the Fusion Reactor Mk2. However, it is more challenging to automate, as it heats up while running, and if it overheats it becomes"
- candidate `chunk-5357f42f7fe58512eb8d1a38b10b512c` doc=doc-2e161bb7490c4c12a7e195acd1873420 words=0-400 distance=0.417610 similarity=0.582390 sections=[Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Progression Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Progression > DTPF Coils Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Progression > Transcendent Plasma Mixer] text="Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) is the eleventh electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. Its focus is scaling the DTPF , unlocked in the previous tier, with improved coils and new sources of catalyst, in order to afford more advanced materials and progress to UMV . It also introduces new, extremely powerful multiblocks such as the Forge of the Gods , as well as the final Creative items and the end of Draconic Evolution progression. UIV is generally considered to mark the transition from lategame to endgame.\nProgression\nDTPF Coils\nAt the start of UIV, the player's DTPF is likely equipped with a set of Infinity coils, which can be used for the Hypogen loop in addition to being required for Tesseracts. The first goal is to use the Hypogen loop to produce the 19,008 ingots worth of Hypogen required to make Hypogen coils.\nWith Hypogen coils, new recipes become available, the most notable of which is SpaceTime, needed for the final coil upgrade, Eternal coils. The SpaceTime recipe available with Hypogen coils is incredibly inefficient, requiring one Tesseract, 16 Infinity, 8 Hypogen, and 10 kL of Dimensionally Transcendent Residue for a single ingot of SpaceTime. A much better recipe is unlocked with Eternal coils, which removes the Hypogen input and is four to eight times as efficient on other inputs, including time, but a full Eternal DTPF requires 20,064 ingots of SpaceTime to make, assuming the much better Black Hole Compressor recipe is used for the Eternal Singularities. In order to achieve this, SpaceTime should be passived and overclocked, and spending SpaceTime on anything other than Eternal coils should be avoided whenever possible.\nEternal coils are effectively the gate for UMV because of how much SpaceTime the tier's components use, and because they are needed for UMV Superconductor Base and Shirabon, both materials required in UMV.\nTranscendent Plasma Mixer\nThe Transcendent Plasma Mixer (TPM) is a multiblock specialized for making DTPF catalyst extremely quickly. It can make each tier of catalyst in a single step, taking 5 seconds per recipe, and can run any number of parallels as set in the GUI, similar to the Waterline multiblocks. If no information is mentioned, they will regular overclock.\nMultiblocks with two energy hatches of the same voltage will always draw 4A to overclock a recipe to a tier higher than the energy hatch voltage (since 4A of the lower voltage contains the same EU as 1A of the higher voltage). Note that Uninsulated Wires have twice the Loss/Meter/Ampere as Insulated Cables. The only exceptions to this are Red alloy and Redstone alloy (as their cables are lossless, while the wires are not), Quantium, Lumiium, and Signalium (four times the loss when uninsulated), and Bedrockium (8x loss when uninsulated).\nFor example:\n- A 1x Tin Cable can handle 1A containing 32EU at a loss of 1 EU-Volt/Meter/Ampere. - candidate `chunk-262bfb224c721dbe8f3769e72b5621b3` doc=doc-c9afb2e028c318ddc2f228663f5523fe words=2560-2815 distance=0.421093 similarity=0.578907 sections=[Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Side Quests > Avaritia Equipment Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Side Quests > Old Stargate Extremely Ultimate Voltage (UEV) > Side Quests > Not a Noob Certificate] text="World Breaker, Nature's Ruin, and Planet Eater are tools capable of mining very large areas at a time, with the World Breaker being especially notable for its ability to break normally unbreakable blocks like Bedrock and its built-in Fortune 10. These features combined allow it to obtain Chaos Shards without actually defeating the Chaos Guardian, and increase the number of shards harvested from 4 to 20.\nOld Stargate\nUEV contains the second of the four old Stargate trophies, the Stargate of Polychrome Contest, corresponding to version 2.1.2.3qf. The materials required are largely similar to the Stargate of Split Origin in UHV, but in approximately four times the quantity: 625 Eternal Singularities, 167k Bio Mainframes, 964k Infinity, 5.9M Tritanium, and 21M UHV Superconductor, among many others. In addition, many of the parts in the Stargate of Polychrome Contest are very slow UIV Assembly Line recipes, meaning they cannot be run in the Advanced Assembly Line until the next tier.\nNot a Noob Certificate\nThe Certificate of not being a noob anymore, more commonly known as the Not a Noob Certificate, is an optional item tied to a quest in the UEV chapter. Unlocking the quest requires the Killing Evolved quest in the Kill All the Things chapter, which itself requires finishing Twilight Forest and Galacticraft progression. The certificate itself is a very slow Extruder recipe; even an Industrial Extrusion Machine with 8 UEV Energy Hatches will take multiple hours to complete it. Other than completing the quest, the Not a Noob Certificate has no practical benefit."
- candidate `chunk-b51940cb91195b8bc18c7ce76bd8306d` doc=doc-04ef7ad9e1765bcf95cbd804c813863b words=0-400 distance=0.423029 similarity=0.576971 sections=[Ultimate Voltage (UV) Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Progression Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Progression > Tier 7 Rocket Ultimate Voltage (UV) > Progression > Wetware Circuits] text="Ultimate Voltage (UV) is the eighth electric tier in GregTech: New Horizons. It is largely centered around the new Wetware circuit line, which introduces new multiblocks like the Quantum Computer and Research Station , as well a-s the new technologies that are unlocked with them, like the third tier of Fusion Reactor . It also introduces many multiblocks for improving infrastructure, including the Mega Alloy Blast Smelter , Component Assembly Line , and Space Elevator , as well as key automation tools like the Stocking Input Hatch.\nProgression\nTier 7 Rocket\nThe Tier 7 Rocket is available as soon as the player is able to power their Assembly Line with two UV Energy Hatches to overclock it to UHV. It unlocks four new planets: Haumea, Makemake, Pluto, and the Kuiper Belt, which should only be mined using Void Miners at this point. The most useful planet to mine is Haumea, which has the earliest source of Nether Star Ore as well as a high chance for Infused Gold Ore, making it very useful for setting up the second tier of Naquadah Fuel. Other new ores are Borax, Red Garnet, Yellow Garnet, and Chrysotile. The available underground fluids are Hydrofluoric Acid on Makemake, and Oxygen, Nitrogen, Fluorine, and Liquid Air on Pluto.\nThe dungeons containing the next tier of schematic are found on Pluto, alongside the Draconic Core Schematic for the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafter . It is highly recommended to place the Tier 8 Rocket Schematic in a singleblock Scanner (a Research Station in Scanner mode will not work) and duplicate it using a UV Circuit Assembler, because two Tier 8 Rocket Schematics will be needed: one for making the Tier 8 Rocket, and one to be researched for the Shuttle Schematic for the Mothership .\nWetware Circuits\nWetwares are the UV circuit line, spanning from LuV to UHV, which are required for advanced UV components and machines and will be used in UHV as an on-tier circuit. Wetwares are the first circuits that require the Assembly Line to produce, using it for the Neuro Processing Units that are required for the first circuit, the Wetwareprocessor. In addition, all UHV and above circuits, of which the Wetware Mainframe is the first, must be made in the Assembly Line and do not have Circuit Assembly Line recipes. The Advanced Assembly Line is highly recommended in order to produce these circuits faster."

You can utilise the Fluid Extractor and Solidifier to produce pipes substantially quicker than with the Bender.\nRevisiting Multiblocks\nSteam Multiblocks are made substantially cheaper in LV with the Bender and Assembler, most of these multiblocks are not superseded until HV or later so it is well worth the investment to build them. - candidate `chunk-19b76a2f4b654304a4b109eb577489fa` doc=doc-626c925b618145e4e43655f7673b36b4 words=1288-1371 distance=0.379358 similarity=0.620642 sections=[Low Voltage (LV) > Energy Conversion > GT EU to Others] text="GT EU to Others\nGT Cables can be attached to almost any machine that requires some kind of energy, allowing a single power network to run machines from most mods in the pack including IC2, EnderIO, Forestry, Railcraft, Galacticraft and more. - candidate `chunk-dd68c611d886bf93d3589f0e90126008` doc=doc-3dbc9b7b97cfc0b8fbe14bc95a57ccc0 words=4546-4642 distance=0.389803 similarity=0.610197 sections=[Electricity > Trivia] text="Trivia\n- GregTech's current power system is called the GT Enet API (Enet).\n- Since version 5.0 (for Minecraft 1.7.2), GregTech has its own Energy System since GregoriusT wasn't satisfied with IC2 Experimental's Energy System.\nThe reasons of why I removed compatibility to the IC² Enet are that Cable Loss doesn't work, that the Network doesn't have Packets anymore and that it switched from Integer to Double (what is horrible for larger Energy Storages). - candidate `chunk-c2ef669309c2e27db516239e863426fc` doc=doc-a9f4f7813df646e0e5f0ab08ab29b50e words=919-961 distance=0.392098 similarity=0.607902 sections=[Ludicrous Voltage (LuV) > Power > Storage and Distribution] text="Storage and Distribution\nThe next tier of Lapotronic Supercapacitor capacitor is unlocked; it provides a massive boost to the total energy storage capacity. - candidate `chunk-e4829a2ca2b7a972615d2ce04ccc31ac` doc=doc-2e161bb7490c4c12a7e195acd1873420 words=2240-2423 distance=0.406989 similarity=0.593011 sections=[Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Infrastructure > Nano Forge and PCB Factory] text="Nano Forge and PCB Factory\nA Tier 3 PCB Factory with a Thermosink Radiator and Biochamber\nThe Tier 3 Nano Forge can be built in early UIV by constructing a second addition to the structure and inserting a Transcendent Metal Nanite into the controller. It unlocks a few new Nanites, but the only ones relevant in UIV are Gold Nanites (needed for QFT catalysts and the tier 3 PCB Factory) and Six-Phased Copper Nanites (required for most Godforge modules). It also provides a perfect overclock on all Tier 2 Nanites, which is particularly valuable for the large amount of Glowstone Nanites needed for Optical circuits.\nThe PCB Factory can be upgraded to Tier 3 after obtaining a Gold Nanite, using a completely new structure. The Tier 3 PCB Factory is similar to the Tier 2, but it gets more circuit boards for the same amount of resources, and uses Gold Nanites instead of Silver Nanites to determine its parallel amount. After obtaining SpaceTime, it can also be upgraded by replacing the Liquid Cooling Tower with the Thermosink Radiator, which allows for perfect overclocks."
- candidate `chunk-afb04b9fc2e8f4f151751978f60aa474` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=816-857 distance=0.408088 similarity=0.591912 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > ExxonMobil Upgrade] text="ExxonMobil Upgrade\nRugged Botmium casings, the final casing tier, are required to produce Mutated Living Solder, a replacement for Molten Indalloy 140 in soldering that is used for circuits starting at Bio, components starting at UEV, and many other lategame recipes."
- candidate `chunk-5d821400c4fafb4037e39ade818840c8` doc=doc-a509849f031bb1dadb346a8565bf75e8 words=1016-1155 distance=0.410842 similarity=0.589158 sections=[Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Godforge Upgrades] text="Graviton Shard left over after completing the END upgrade. Combined with the 6 Graviton Shards that can be immediately obtained from placing a Heliofusion Exoticizer in Magmatter mode, it is possible to get the TPTP upgrade even if the player did not originally go down the right path in the upgrade tree's split. This upgrade is necessary for producing Magmatter, since some of the plasmas that the recipe can request are multi-step, and can only be made in the Plasma Fabricator.\nIn addition to Graviton Shards, many of the upgrades also require items to be inserted to complete them. The most notable costs are the Eternity and Universium needed for the last two upgrades, forcing them to be unlocked only after a tier 7 Eye of Harmony, and the 24 total UMV batteries required for all of the upgrades."

- candidate `chunk-19b76a2f4b654304a4b109eb577489fa` doc=doc-626c925b618145e4e43655f7673b36b4 words=1288-1371 distance=0.379358 similarity=0.620642 sections=[Low Voltage (LV) > Energy Conversion > GT EU to Others] text="GT EU to Others\nGT Cables can be attached to almost any machine that requires some kind of energy, allowing a single power network to run machines from most mods in the pack including IC2, EnderIO, Forestry, Railcraft, Galacticraft and more. - candidate `chunk-dd68c611d886bf93d3589f0e90126008` doc=doc-3dbc9b7b97cfc0b8fbe14bc95a57ccc0 words=4546-4642 distance=0.389803 similarity=0.610197 sections=[Electricity > Trivia] text="Trivia\n- GregTech's current power system is called the GT Enet API (Enet).\n- Since version 5.0 (for Minecraft 1.7.2), GregTech has its own Energy System since GregoriusT wasn't satisfied with IC2 Experimental's Energy System.\nThe reasons of why I removed compatibility to the IC² Enet are that Cable Loss doesn't work, that the Network doesn't have Packets anymore and that it switched from Integer to Double (what is horrible for larger Energy Storages). - candidate `chunk-c2ef669309c2e27db516239e863426fc` doc=doc-a9f4f7813df646e0e5f0ab08ab29b50e words=919-961 distance=0.392098 similarity=0.607902 sections=[Ludicrous Voltage (LuV) > Power > Storage and Distribution] text="Storage and Distribution\nThe next tier of Lapotronic Supercapacitor capacitor is unlocked; it provides a massive boost to the total energy storage capacity. - candidate `chunk-e4829a2ca2b7a972615d2ce04ccc31ac` doc=doc-2e161bb7490c4c12a7e195acd1873420 words=2240-2423 distance=0.406989 similarity=0.593011 sections=[Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Infrastructure > Nano Forge and PCB Factory] text="Nano Forge and PCB Factory\nA Tier 3 PCB Factory with a Thermosink Radiator and Biochamber\nThe Tier 3 Nano Forge can be built in early UIV by constructing a second addition to the structure and inserting a Transcendent Metal Nanite into the controller. It unlocks a few new Nanites, but the only ones relevant in UIV are Gold Nanites (needed for QFT catalysts and the tier 3 PCB Factory) and Six-Phased Copper Nanites (required for most Godforge modules). It also provides a perfect overclock on all Tier 2 Nanites, which is particularly valuable for the large amount of Glowstone Nanites needed for Optical circuits.\nThe PCB Factory can be upgraded to Tier 3 after obtaining a Gold Nanite, using a completely new structure. The Tier 3 PCB Factory is similar to the Tier 2, but it gets more circuit boards for the same amount of resources, and uses Gold Nanites instead of Silver Nanites to determine its parallel amount. After obtaining SpaceTime, it can also be upgraded by replacing the Liquid Cooling Tower with the Thermosink Radiator, which allows for perfect overclocks."
- candidate `chunk-afb04b9fc2e8f4f151751978f60aa474` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=816-857 distance=0.408088 similarity=0.591912 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > ExxonMobil Upgrade] text="ExxonMobil Upgrade\nRugged Botmium casings, the final casing tier, are required to produce Mutated Living Solder, a replacement for Molten Indalloy 140 in soldering that is used for circuits starting at Bio, components starting at UEV, and many other lategame recipes."
- candidate `chunk-5d821400c4fafb4037e39ade818840c8` doc=doc-a509849f031bb1dadb346a8565bf75e8 words=1016-1155 distance=0.410842 similarity=0.589158 sections=[Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Godforge Upgrades] text="Graviton Shard left over after completing the END upgrade. Combined with the 6 Graviton Shards that can be immediately obtained from placing a Heliofusion Exoticizer in Magmatter mode, it is possible to get the TPTP upgrade even if the player did not originally go down the right path in the upgrade tree's split. This upgrade is necessary for producing Magmatter, since some of the plasmas that the recipe can request are multi-step, and can only be made in the Plasma Fabricator.\nIn addition to Graviton Shards, many of the upgrades also require items to be inserted to complete them. The most notable costs are the Eternity and Universium needed for the last two upgrades, forcing them to be unlocked only after a tier 7 Eye of Harmony, and the 24 total UMV batteries required for all of the upgrades."

- candidate `chunk-dd68c611d886bf93d3589f0e90126008` doc=doc-3dbc9b7b97cfc0b8fbe14bc95a57ccc0 words=4546-4642 distance=0.389803 similarity=0.610197 sections=[Electricity > Trivia] text="Trivia\n- GregTech's current power system is called the GT Enet API (Enet).\n- Since version 5.0 (for Minecraft 1.7.2), GregTech has its own Energy System since GregoriusT wasn't satisfied with IC2 Experimental's Energy System.\nThe reasons of why I removed compatibility to the IC² Enet are that Cable Loss doesn't work, that the Network doesn't have Packets anymore and that it switched from Integer to Double (what is horrible for larger Energy Storages). - candidate `chunk-c2ef669309c2e27db516239e863426fc` doc=doc-a9f4f7813df646e0e5f0ab08ab29b50e words=919-961 distance=0.392098 similarity=0.607902 sections=[Ludicrous Voltage (LuV) > Power > Storage and Distribution] text="Storage and Distribution\nThe next tier of Lapotronic Supercapacitor capacitor is unlocked; it provides a massive boost to the total energy storage capacity. - candidate `chunk-e4829a2ca2b7a972615d2ce04ccc31ac` doc=doc-2e161bb7490c4c12a7e195acd1873420 words=2240-2423 distance=0.406989 similarity=0.593011 sections=[Insanely Ultimate Voltage (UIV) > Infrastructure > Nano Forge and PCB Factory] text="Nano Forge and PCB Factory\nA Tier 3 PCB Factory with a Thermosink Radiator and Biochamber\nThe Tier 3 Nano Forge can be built in early UIV by constructing a second addition to the structure and inserting a Transcendent Metal Nanite into the controller. It unlocks a few new Nanites, but the only ones relevant in UIV are Gold Nanites (needed for QFT catalysts and the tier 3 PCB Factory) and Six-Phased Copper Nanites (required for most Godforge modules). It also provides a perfect overclock on all Tier 2 Nanites, which is particularly valuable for the large amount of Glowstone Nanites needed for Optical circuits.\nThe PCB Factory can be upgraded to Tier 3 after obtaining a Gold Nanite, using a completely new structure. The Tier 3 PCB Factory is similar to the Tier 2, but it gets more circuit boards for the same amount of resources, and uses Gold Nanites instead of Silver Nanites to determine its parallel amount. After obtaining SpaceTime, it can also be upgraded by replacing the Liquid Cooling Tower with the Thermosink Radiator, which allows for perfect overclocks."
- candidate `chunk-afb04b9fc2e8f4f151751978f60aa474` doc=doc-8bdfdac1b12c28b48cfd59b3c35795d1 words=816-857 distance=0.408088 similarity=0.591912 sections=[Highly Ultimate Voltage (UHV) > Progression > ExxonMobil Upgrade] text="ExxonMobil Upgrade\nRugged Botmium casings, the final casing tier, are required to produce Mutated Living Solder, a replacement for Molten Indalloy 140 in soldering that is used for circuits starting at Bio, components starting at UEV, and many other lategame recipes."
- candidate `chunk-5d821400c4fafb4037e39ade818840c8` doc=doc-a509849f031bb1dadb346a8565bf75e8 words=1016-1155 distance=0.410842 similarity=0.589158 sections=[Mega Ultimate Voltage (UMV) > Progression > Godforge Upgrades] text="Graviton Shard left over after completing the END upgrade. Combined with the 6 Graviton Shards that can be immediately obtained from placing a Heliofusion Exoticizer in Magmatter mode, it is possible to get the TPTP upgrade even if the player did not originally go down the right path in the upgrade tree's split. This upgrade is necessary for producing Magmatter, since some of the plasmas that the recipe can request are multi-step, and can only be made in the Plasma Fabricator.\nIn addition to Graviton Shards, many of the upgrades also require items to be inserted to complete them. The most notable costs are the Eternity and Universium needed for the last two upgrades, forcing them to be unlocked only after a tier 7 Eye of Harmony, and the 24 total UMV batteries required for all of the upgrades."
